notes.title: The Monster Arcade Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/2fc8439244eadbeb27a5082ea1cd762b72a36c6d.png[/img]

Hello Creators,

Have you ever wished you could create your very own arcade? Or a monster house? Or a monster-themed arcade? Well now you can in our latest update, which also adds some fixes and improvements. As always, thank you for playing Creativerse, and enjoy!

[list]
[*]Four new Arcade Cabinet variants of stations
[list]
[*]Purple Cabinet & Base - Processor
[*]Dark Blue Cabinet & Base - Forge
[*]Light Blue Cabinet & Base - Crafting
[*]Red Cabinet & Base - Cooking
[*]Base Blocks for the above unlock on the stations themselves (e.g. Arcade 
Processor Base unlocks on Arcade Processor)
[/list][*]New plain variant of the Retro Arcade Carpet, including shape variants (slab, slope, slice, etc.)
[*]Five new Monster Blocks
[list]
[*]Monster Eye
[*]Monster Scales
[*]Small Monster Scales
[*]Monster Fur
[*]Gelatinous Block
[*]Recipes added to "monster" type mob drops (e.g. Miru, Thing)
[*]Shape variants included for all the above except the eye
[/list][*]Six new Figurines (added to Thing's loot table)
[list]
[*]5 Ghost Figures (common)
[*]Pumpkiru figure (rare)
[/list][*]New Pointed Hat for pets (added to drop tables for higher-tier treasure chests, along with pet bowties, etc)
[*]New world settings to change the growth times of crops, queen bees, mushrooms and trees
[*]Added various world settings to change mining times
[*]Improved world creation wizard
[*]Added support for custom local loading screen in the game settings, with a button to open the folder from which to pick images (JPG or PNG)
[*]Fixed problem with the Mailbox UI and the Picture Frame UIs losing control of the mouse after alt-tabbing
[*]Fixed Trog Traps capture events [i.e. capture the flag (snow 2 go) and base defend (king of the chill)]
[*]Changed Haunted Mirror painting mask, secondary paint now affects the mirror part and the spiderwebs, paint glow sliders affect whiteness of the spiderweb
[*]Fix Golden Sword not showing up in the crafting list
[/list]

notes.title: Creativerse Update — Aug 2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/a4a0c0f5f5c1eddb4e1271359e903773f5f154fb.jpg[/img]

Hello Creators,

We’re back with another decent sized Creativerse update! This time we’ve focused a lot on quality of life improvements, with an overhauled settings menu that finally unshackles post-processing effects like depth of field, color grading, ambient occlusion, and more, allowing you to make them permanent (like in the featured screenshot). There’s a new Vending Machine item that you can customize to allow trades of any item for another item, so if you want to make the entire Lumite Armor set cost 5 dirt blocks, you sure can. And there’s a ton of other stuff like this – so please do check out what may be our longest patch notes ever!

[b]Map:[/b]
[list]
New Map Warping feature! Warp to any location by clicking on the map view while holding the Sprint key…[list]
[*]Works at both zoom levels
[*]Works regardless of map fog
[*]You can customize the altitude at which you are teleported from the game settings
Requires the following:[list]
[*]The player must enable it in the game settings (in Misc tab)
[*]The player must have access to Creator Mode and the `/warp` command in the world[/list][/list]
[*]Added world coordinates in map view as you hover the mouse around
[/list]
[b]New Mob variant:[/b]
[list]
[*]Night Truffl!
[/list]
[b]Game settings / preferences:[/b]
[list]
[*]Completely new settings interface!
[*]Settings menu now includes all preferences, including post-processing options only available in Photo Mode or via chat commands or manually altering a configuration file
[*]For example, you can now have on by default settings like tilt-shift, the kuwahara effect, high contrast, vignettes, etc.
[*]Added an editor for custom paint values
[*]Allow the settings window to be manually resized
[*]Increased max Target Framerate from 120 to 240
[*]Fixed Shadow Quality changes not getting applied on the fly
[*]Added setting to disable map view movement with forward / back / left / right bindings to allow unusual bindings such as primary mouse button > forward (interface buttons will still work)
[*]Added horizontal / vertical / sprint settings to affect movement speed when hovering in Creator Mode
[*]Added setting to customize Creator Mode first / third person reach distance (i.e. how far you can pull / place blocks)
[*]Added setting to allow long reach distance for wiring in Creator Mode (defaults to false)
[*]Added settings to alter Camera Drone acceleration, drag, and sprint multipliers
[*]Added horizontal / vertical sensitivity settings for the glider (separate settings for mouse and alpha controller)
[*]Added setting to hide the Gliding Controls while gliding
[*]Added settings to make crouch-descending optional:[list]
[*]While swimming (defaults to true)
[*]While climbing (defaults to false)
[*]While hovering in Creator Mode (defaults to false)[/list]
[*]Added settings to enable / disable block copying:[list]
[*]While in Survival (defaults to false)
[*]While in Creator Mode (defaults to true)[/list]
[*]Added setting to enable Map Warping (see New Map Warping feature section below)
[*]Added altitude setting to be used by Map Warping
[/list]
[b]New Vending Machine / Shop Catalogs feature:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Vending Machine block
[*]Each placed Vending Machine can be set to use one or more Catalogs
[*]Each Catalog can contain multiple Trades, where each Trade can have multiple items / blocks to be given or received
[*]Each Catalog can be set as Restricted, so that only Admins / Owners can pick such Catalogs in a Vending Machine
[*]Catalogs can be edited from the Vending Machine (if you have rights to do so) or from the Tools page in the Webadmin
[*]No Catalogs are defined by default but there's a button to quickly create Recycling Catalogs for all Gauntlets / Weapons / Armor / Tools (by default they will give back half of the resources needed to craft such items)
[*]Additional buttons to create Trades for recipes and crafts
[*]You have full control over each Trade even after it's autogenerated with the above buttons
[*]Allows adding Trades to be bought to a Cart and to receive the items in a Crate instead of sparse items
[/list]
[b]Additional new blocks / items:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new "almost seamless" version for the Western Log Cabin Wall blocks (old versions are still extant to avoid disrupting existing builds, and can be combined with the new versions to achieve better matching internal / external walls around a build)
[*]Added Canvas Maze Straight block (only the straight pattern all around all faces)
[*]Added Stucco Wall variants
[*]Added Ruddy Stucco Wall variants
[*]Added Dark Stucco Wall variants
[*]Added 10 missing summoners
[/list]
[b]World settings / world creation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added World Creation Wizard with four new presets
[*]World Creation Wizard appears when clicking on the Create World card on the Play > Local tab or clicking on the Create menu button, and can be disabled from the Play screen settings and can be opened at any time from a button in the Create World page
[*]Added world setting to enable Crafting Tables spawning in the wild (like it was during early access!)
[*]Added world setting to Disable Crafting (i.e. via backpack; recommended you also turn Crafting Table spawning on)
[*]Added world setting to disable empty Teleporters
[*]Added world setting to disable Arc Portals with code set to zero
[*]Added world settings to unlock the Glider, the Flashlight, and the Gauntlet Smash / Power Attack, which default to “none” (aka unlocked) unless using the Full Progression preset in the World Creation Wizard
[*]Added Extended Grass Spread world setting (see below)
[*]Added world setting to decide if you want to share players counts (total, online last day / week / month / year)
[/list]
[b]New extended grass spread feature:[/b]
[list]
[*]Brown Mushrooms turn into Brown Mushroom on Grass (near Grass or other Grass-versions of the Brown Mushrooms)
[*]Brown Mushrooms on Grass also cause Grass to appear onto nearby Dirt
[*]Detritus and Matted Needles can spread onto Dirt as well (if Detritus, Matted Needles and Grass are fighting to spread onto the same Dirt block, one will be picked at random)
[*]Note: Savannah Grass will continue spreading onto Rocky Dirt
[*]Turned off by default; requires changing the option in the world settings
[/list]
[b]Alpha controller support:[/b]
[list]
[*]Allow detecting input from controllers while rebinding the controls
[*]Only works during gameplay; doesn't support interacting with UI
[*]Note: it may still be possible to manipulate UI via Steam controller remapping
[/list]
[b]Building improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduce bumping of character placing blocks too close: 
[list]
[*]Either you're too close and you can't place that block or you're far enough and you don't get bumped back
[*]Exceptions allowed for touchstone, liquids, torches, climbing items (e.g. ladders and vines)
[*]Added ability to copy blocks and BP hints while in Survival Mode (requires enabling a new preference in Misc tab)[/list][/list]
[b]Villagers / NPCs:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added minutes / seconds to "I have everything" message to troubleshoot NPC's loot
[*]Added missing Corruption contentment reference to Logger Villager
[*]Added missing Coal contentment reference to Miner Villager
[*]Reordered Rancher Villager contentments; hopefully should make for rarer / tougher tamed pets being picked up before stray wandering mobs
[*]Fixed Villager jobs starting unlocked without the need to find the corresponding Unlock Chips
[/list]
[b]User Interface polish:[/b]
[list]
Play screen:[list]
[*]Improved template download feedback (total + remaining time)
[*]Added error display on the Play screen in the event server.json is malformed, which can cause using the incorrect folder for local worlds and templates
[*]Added support for launching local worlds appending -forceIp=0.0.0.0 (option in the Play screen settings)[/list]
[*]Play > Local tab:[list]
[*]Added "World Paths" button to local worlds preview card, dialog with buttons to open the world folder, and the world backups folder
[*]Added button to create `.bat` launchers from the world paths of the local world card previews[/list]
[*]Play > Online tabs:[list]
[*]Only show compatible worlds by default (and add toggle to show incompatible ones as well)
[*]Added owner name to world preview cards[/list]
[*]Improvements to the Forge interface for a consistent font type
[*]Improvements to ESC screen is alignment
[*]Fixed Touchstone interface not adapting to the screen and not rendering darker background correctly
[*]Fixed white flashing when opening Mailbox
[/list]
[b]Badges / Perks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed quests not granting the intended perk at the completion of a badge
[*]Note: if you have customized the Quests file previously, you may need to delete such customizations and re-complete the quests, or add the intended perk to the last quest relative to a specific badge, or manually unlock the desired perks on a per-player basis from the Playerlist.
[/list]
[b]New World Overrides customization:[/b]
[list]
[*]Can be accessed from the World editing while in-game or from the Tools page in the Webadmin
[*]Allows customizing which blocks/items can be crafted, pulled, or placed
[*]Supports whitelisting mode (pick the blocks you want to allow, all the others are disallowed) and blacklist mode (pick the blocks you want to disallow, all the others are allowed)
[*]Supports syncing the place / pull lists
[*]Supports specifying which roles will not be affected by such overrides (so that you can prevent builders from placing certain blocks but still allow that to Mods / Admins)
[/list]
[b]Webadmin:[/b]
[list]
[*]Allow removal of individual claims belonging to anyone (via claims page and map page)
[*]Allow batch editing of players; appears when selecting multiple records via shift+click or control+click
[*]Fixed wrong water altitude rendering + paint bottom black row for End of the World blocks in slices rendering of the islands-simplex editor
[/list]
[b]Playerlist:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed players not promptly marked as online / offline in the in-game playerlist as they log in / disconnect
[*]Allow owners to edit anyone, and admins to edit lower permission players, the following:[list]
[*]Lock/unlock crafts, costumes, discoveries, villager jobs, perks
[*]Note: can only be performed on players which are online
[*]Unlocking large amounts at once may cause the client of that player to freeze due from the resulting notifications[/list]
[*]Added ability to change the amount of Unlocked Claims when editing a player
[*]Added pending count marker to hammer icon at the top (i.e. to see at a glance any requests you haven't handled yet)
[/list]
[b]New Built-in Game Reference:[/b]
[list]
[*]Accessible from the ESC menu while in a world and from the Tools page of the Webadmin; includes the following info:[list]
[*]How to unlock a craft where applicable (unlock sequence or needed recipe)
[*]How to obtain a block / item (potential biomes, potential drops from mobs / treasures, potential transformations from Gauntlet Smash and Plant/Un-Plant Bombs)
[*]Spawning rules for mobs / Villagers
[*]Job contentments for Programmable Villagers
[*]Contents of any lore collectible (Crash Dumps, Torn Journal Pages and so forth)[/list][/list]
[b]Chat commands:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added `/finddeathstatue` chat command
[*]Allow world co-owners to use all chat commands by default
[*]Fixed broken autocomplete of `/pref` listing
[*]Fixed `/cube dig` and `/cuboid dig` generating error blocks while digging blocks which create entities (chests, doors, signs, etc.)
[*]Added support for paint action to the `/aimed` command and improve the matching rules
[*]Improved chat feedback about the used matching rules when running the `/aimed` command
[/list]
[b]Naming:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bunch of block > item naming mismatches
[*]Fixed a few mob/summoner naming mismatches
[*]Fixed Legendary and normal Golden Swords recipe names / descriptions swapped around
[*]Fixed a few recipe naming inconsistencies and typos
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous improvements and fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Stamina Regeneration Potion to the Creator Mode menu
[*]Added Frosty Leafi Leaf to the valid vegetable ingredients for Sandwiches and Soup
[*]Fixed Ice Cap using Dirt instead of Ice
[*]Fixed Blueprint kit purchase button not working on Blueprint and cornerstone pages
[*]Fixed Atlantis Table showing up in the Obsidian section of the build crafting tab
[*]Fixed weapon remaining attached to the gauntlet when switching over to Creator Mode while in Combat Mode
[*]Improved wood brightness inconsistency between the Forbidden Window and the Forbidden Lattice window (the dark one is now slightly lighter)
[*]Improved side texture of Stone Slab to better match rest of the set
[*]Changed Automated Chest to be explosion proof and prohibit players from editing / wiring it unless they are also able to pull the block itself
[*]Processing times are now instant for column / slab / slice / slope / stairs & various corner variants, with some exceptions (e.g. slabs made out of ore bars will keep their timers for the sake of the survival progression)
[*]Allow anyone to use a Mailbox, even if it's on a claimed spot where they don't have any permissions (players will only see their own messages)
[*]Fixed treasure chests visual glitch "casting darkness"
[*]Added missing unlocks for Adobe Floors (Red / Blue / Yellow)
[*]Added missing unlocks for Mosaic Tile Walls (Red / Blue / Yellow)
[*]Added system chat message about unread mailbox messages upon joining a world
[*]Added system chat message anytime you receive a new mailbox message
[*]Fixed tamed ghost mobs not giving loot
[*]Fixed Reaudolph not being washable
[*]Tweaked occlusion rules to minimize faces of blocks being rendered when they shouldn't (e.g. when they're hidden by the surrounding blocks)
[*]Fixed some cases of distant bright yellow / orange flashes at night moving around as you load in certain types of terrain (for example Grass blocks)
[*]Added sprites tables page (linked from the Sprites Picker)
[*]Fixed Sprites Picker not listing recipe books / scrolls / chips / journals / torn pages
[*]Fixed server overwriting existing world log files; will now append to them instead
[*]Ensured server console prints out errors about missing -worldId= param or malformed server.json, such errors go in a new /logs/server start failure.log file
[*]Changed custom post-processing file save location to: ‘AppData\LocalLow\PlayfulCorp\Creativerse\config\post_processing.json’ – Note: this is just an FYI as the post-processing settings can now be edited in the new Settings interface
[/list]

notes.title: Backups now available for nearly every Creativerse world
notes.notes:
Hello Creators,

We have good news! We now have backups available for nearly every Creativerse world created by players. If you missed your chance to download a copy before we shut down the legacy servers, you can reach out to us to get a copy. Just email your request along with your Steam ID to [url=mailto:support@playfulstudios.com]support@playfulstudios.com[/url].

As a reminder, releasing The Definitive Edition was primarily about keeping the game from disappearing overnight once we could no longer justify the business costs of keeping the servers and various other live-ops services up and running. There have been growing pains along the way but we're ultimately trying to do right by the community and we appreciate your patience through this process. And now we're thrilled that we can offer players a backup for each world they created.

One note: we were unable to recover a very small number of worlds (less than 0.5%) due to data corruption.

We're about halfway through development on the game's next update. Can't wait to share more with you soon. Until then, stay creative!

notes.title: Creativerse: The Definitive Edition is now a free upgrade for F2P players
notes.notes:
[h3][i][b]UPDATE, Jun 27: Definitive Edition purchasers have until July 31 to claim a free copy for a friend.[/b][/i][/h3]

Greetings Creators,

We highly value and appreciate everyone who has enjoyed Creativerse over the years. Thanks to your feedback, we've decided that a better way to show our appreciation to our existing community is offering a free upgrade to The Definitive Edition to anyone who played the original free version of the game. That's nearly 5 million people!

As of today, if you have ANY previous hours in the free version of the game, you should receive the upgrade automatically. If for some reason you didn't, reach out to us so we can help you: [url=mailto:support@playfulstudios.com]support@playfulstudios.com[/url]

And to keep things fair, if you purchased The Definitive Edition and haven't already claimed a free copy for a friend during our promotion last spring, we will gift a free copy to any friend of your choosing. Just forward your Steam receipt to us ([url=mailto:support@playfulstudios.com]support@playfulstudios.com[/url]) and include a link to your friend's Steam profile page. (UPDATE, June 12: please note this offer only applies to purchases as of today's date.)

Lastly, if you'd like to support us, consider writing (or updating) a review of the game on Steam.

Thanks everyone, and stay creative!

notes.title: The Collectables Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/b0a1e9bbf09c19470bd85e8625c1b67d54999bc2.png[/img]

Hello Creators!

Turns out Thing is quite the collector, and now its collection can be yours. These shiny new figurines — which feature your favorite Creativerse mobs like Pigsy, Leafi, Chizzard, Rambeau, Rockster, Keepa, and more — will look great in your builds! So if you're feeling adventurous, head down to the Corruption Layer and fight or tame some Things to start collecting. It won't be easy but it will be worth it.

In addition, we have some new items and a bunch of improvements, including a big overhaul to loot from treasure chests, which are now way more rewarding. We've added the ability to customize the length of timers in advanced world options, so now you can process and forge everything in 1 second if you like. There’s several new chat commands that add some useful tinkering abilities. And more!

This update also removes the ability to migrate your old worlds (...end of an era). Until next time...stay creative!

[h2][u]New Content[/u][/h2]

[h3]New Collectable Figures[/h3]
Thing now has a chance to drop collectable figures straight from its amazing collection of things!
[list]
[*]Six new common figures:[list]
[*]Playful Pigsy
[*]Inquisitive Leafi
[*]Flamboyant Chizzard
[*]Rambunctious Rambeau
[*]Splashing Karrotfish
[*]Friendly Rockster[/list][*]Three new rare figures:
[list][*]Golden Keepa
[*]Waving QB
[*]Baby Leafi Stack[/list][*]…More?[/list]
[h3]New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added the Year of the Rabbit Lantern
[*]Added the rest of the missing "Year of…" lanterns:[list]
[*]Year of the Dragon Lantern
[*]Year of the Goat Lantern
[*]Year of the Horse Lantern
[*]Year of the Monkey Lantern
[*]Year of the Rooster Lantern
[*]Year of the Snake Lantern
[*]Year of the Tiger Lantern[/list][*]Keepa is the keeper of these new recipes!
[/list]
[h2][u]Improvements & Fixes[/u][/h2]

[h3]Loot:[/h3][list]
[*]50+ home decor recipes (including the Ritzy Pigsy Hotel and Better Home sets) added as potential loot from tamed mobs
[*]"Frozen" recipes now have a chance to drop from cold mobs
[*]Special treasure chests with a chance to drop "Atlantis" and other ocean-themed recipes now sometimes appear near shores
[*]Stacked Crates recipe added to Wood Treasure Chests
[*]Death Statue recipe now has a chance to drop from any night mob
[*]Optimized treasure chests loot overall – more distinction between chest tiers, and good stuff generally has a better and more consistent chance to drop
[/list]
[h3]Mobs:[/h3][list]
[*]Reaudolph is now tamable
[*]Troggington is now tamable
[*]Fixed arcstones not dropping from tamed Keepas and Keepa ranchers
[/list]
[h3]World Options:[/h3][list]
[*]Added option to change timing on the Forge, Processor, and Extractor (Edit World > Advanced Settings > Crafting)
[/list]
[h3]Repairing:[/h3][list]
[*]Rocket Pack is now repairable
[/list]
[h3]Entities:[/h3][list]
[*]Increased storage size of most chests
[*]Improved Picture Frame / Arc Picture Frame interface
[*]Picture Frame images are now sourced from our Artwork page on Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/images/
[*]Fixed freshly placed teleporters (empty ones) not pairing up
[*]Fixed problem with autobuilt teleporters not retaining their captured codes
[/list]
[h3]UI & Menus:[/h3][list]
[*]Removed Migrate link and relative functionality from the main screen
[*]Updated names of various plants to indicate which ones are placeable
[*]Long item names no longer gets cut off on item description tooltips
[*]Improved visibility of the block cursor, making it easier to see on bright surfaces
[*]In-game help buttons now link to official help website
[*]Improved differentiation between editable and non-editable world forms in Server Browser
[*]Fixed inconsistent MaxPlayers default from 100 to 20
[*]Small tweaks and missing items fixed in NPC trader UIs
[/list]
[h3]Player Character:[/h3][list]
[*]Updated animation when equipping boots to match that of leggings for consistency
[*]Fixed bug resetting player face to default when equipping boots
[/list]
[h3]Player Management:[/h3][list]
[*]Renamed "cheat" to "command" in player list management
[*]Added for visibility commands which are always allowed and not editable
[*]Added link to player’s Steam profile in the player management dialog
[*]Added whitelist & blacklist buttons to player management dialog
[*]Added category links to playerlist manage commands overlay
[/list]
[h3]Commands (formerly cheats):[/h3][list]
[*]New commands added:
[list]
[*]/npcrange – shows the sensing range of a Programmable Villager
[*]/grid  – allows creating grids of arbitrary sizes and alignments
[*]/markers –  allows customizing duration and colors of test / action markers
[*]/mirror – mirror an existing build, either moving or duplicating the placed blocks.
[*]/rotate – rotate an existing build
[*]/custompaint – allows saving / loading / clearing custom paint intensities
[/list][*]Certain commands are now automatically granted to players
[*]/sphere and /spheretest no longer requires separated width / height / depth params
[*]/aimed command now replaces / digs liquids when the rotation flag is set (which is by default)
[*]Improved feedback when attempting to use a banned command
[*]Improved /poly command
[*]More details on commands and their usage is available in Manage Commands > “i” icon (toggle info); (if you aren’t the world owner, open your own record in the player list and click View Commands)
[/list]
[h3]Chat:[/h3][list]
[*]Whispers now prepend with sender name (only for the sender) to differentiate sent messages from received ones
[*]New player preferences added:
[list]
[*]/pref Use24Hours true|false – forces 24 hour time format regardless of any locale setting
[*]/pref UseCelsius true|false` – forces showing C° values instead of F° values
[*]/pref NPCVerboseOutput true|false` – gives more details in chat regarding NPC containment failures (i.e. when an NPC says “I don’t have what I need”)[/list][/list]
[h3]Paint / Textures:[/h3]
Made improvements to paint masks and/or paint intensities for the following:
[list]
[*]Wood Roof
[*]Wood Stairs
[*]Diamond Wall
[*]Old Wood
[*]Adobe Roof
[*]Thatched Roof
[*]Goo block sets
[*]Gold Stairs
[/list]
[h3]Web Admin:[/h3][list]
[*]Improved the webadmin reference utility
[*]Fixed claims missing from the webadmin map
[*]Fixed islands-simplex generator not forcing the correct procedural type in the resulting mapinfo.json files
[*]Quests editor now supports Days in Repeat Time Span field
[*]Fixed help button in Creatisprites Picker wrongly filling the grid randomly
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed various blocks not unlocking correctly
[*]Uniform processing time for Diamond Node Variants, Diamond Wall Slices/Slabs
[*]Fixed Diamond Wall Slice not being processed from Diamond Wall Slab
[*]Fixed Diamond Quarter Round Slope not processed out of Diamond Wall Column
[*]Fixed Adobe Brick variants not being processable
[*]Improved output for data dumps (reference js files you can download by typing /createmedia in chat)
[/list]
version 4.0.0

notes.title: PSA: Only 2 weeks left to download your worlds!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Creators,[/h2]

How goes the building and adventuring in Creativerse? Hopefully fantastically!

We wanted to remind you of the upcoming [b]April 6th deadline[/b]—a little over 2 weeks from now—before we have to shut down the original Creativerse servers.

This is your last chance to download your own worlds, or any whitelisted public worlds (search for “migrationallowed” in the migration tab).

Once the servers are shut down, we won’t be able to recover any world data. We know our players have put millions of hours into building amazing things, so please take the time to download and backup it up!

If you haven’t yet purchased The Definitive Edition, now would be a great time as the game is currently 50% off for the Spring Sale. Also don’t forget if you’ve spent over a certain amount on Creativerse, we’ll gift a copy of the game to any friend of your choosing. The deadline to apply for that is [b]March 31[/b]. More details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/280790/announcements/detail/3674409756516293603]here[/url].

Our next update is coming soon! Until then, stay creative!!

—The Playful Team

notes.title: Get Creativerse 50% off, plus a free copy of the game for a friend
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Creators,[/h2]

We wanted to let you know about some special deals going on right now, as well as an extension of the deadline to migrate worlds.

But first, the deals!

[h3]1. The Definitive Edition of the game is 50% off this week![/h3]

If you haven't picked it up yet, this is a great chance to get the new, improved, and future-proofed version of the game.

Go directly to the store page: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/280790/Creativerse/ 

[h3]2. We are pleased to announce a new promotion we like to call [b]"More Creatifriends!"[/b][/h3]

We are offering a FREE copy of The Definitive Edition to any friend of your choosing if you've supported us above a certain amount.

Specifically, if you've spent more than $30 USD on the game, or, for international players, the equivalent of $30 USD in your local currency, which might look like one of the following combinations:

[list]
[*] Pro + Welcome Bundle DLCs
[*] Pro + any 2 coin bundles
[*] Pro + any 1 coin bundle + Soundtrack DLC
[*] Creativerse: The Definitive Edition + Soundtrack DLC
[*] Any combination of coin bundles equal to $30 USD (or local equivalent)
[/list]
And if you've spent more than $60 USD (or local equivalent), you can pick TWO friends to get the game for free!

Just send your player name or Steam ID to [b]support@playfulstudios.com[/b] with the subject "free copy for a friend" and we'll get it sorted. 

[b]The deadline to contact us is MARCH 31.[/b]

If you aren't sure if you qualify, email us anyway and we'll figure it out with you. Because the game is always better with more Creatifriends!

[i]UPDATE, 2/7: One point of clarification: if you purchase The Definitive Edition on sale plus the soundtrack you won't qualify for the free copy unless you also have purchased $10 USD (or local equivalent) in coins OR the Welcome Bundle.[/i]

[h3]DATA DEADLINE EXTENSION[/h3]

We’ve decided to extend the deadline for migrating your worlds and data an additional 30 days. This means you have until [b]APRIL 6[/b] to download your data from our servers before we have to shut them down.

Remember, you can download local copies of any world you owned before we switched to The Definitive Edition. You can also download any worlds that other players have flagged to allow public migration (and there are a bunch of popular ones out there, e.g. the Playfulverse worlds we featured on livestreams back in the day).

They are all yours for the taking but please [b]remember to migrate them before April 6, 2023![/b]


That's it for now. We are hard at work on the next update, which we hope to release before the end of the month. In the meantime, stay creative!

—The Playful Team

notes.title: Creativerse: The Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/80c7b4e94dd3a19e9c2165be6845996a597c98a7.png[/img]

[h3]At long last, The Definitive Edition of Creativerse is here![/h3]

This update is the culmination of 8 years of development and everything our players love about the game, all in a new pay-once-play-forever package. As we explained [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/280790/view/6187408300313244562]earlier this fall[/url], we decided to pivot away from free-to-play in this new version that removes the Playful-hosted elements and puts the entire game into your hands.

This change allowed us to make things vastly more customizable for players. Want a world with infinite stamina, a 1 second timer on all processor materials, one-hit kills on all mobs, and holiday events turned on year-round? Done. Want under-the-hood options for managing a server, its players, and backups? You got it. In fact, if this pivot proves successful, we could add support for even wilder stuff like mods. And while multiplayer will now be up to players to host, there will still be a list of public worlds to join.

On top of this, we've added a ton of new content and improvements, overhauled the core progression loop, and added a new mailbox tool for sending messages to players in other worlds. There's also a bunch of new tools for managing your world and its players, including a separate web admin interface with a lot of neat extras.

Here are 2 important details you should know:

1. If you purchased either DLC or bought coins, this is a free update!

2. For the next 90 days, you'll be able to migrate all of your worlds from our servers. You can also migrate any worlds other players have whitelisted for download. [b][i]Please download your worlds asap and back them up[/i][/b], as we won't be able to recover them once the deadline has passed!

Finally, for more details, check out our [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/18vQTE_AKyu-IEsxXMPbc0QFcJdZvhBkblcmz8yzzqSo/edit#heading=h.5drlcg38zjs2]FAQ[/url]. And for an extensive dive into the ins and outs of this new version, check out [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rAeuk7qFinUyPRJGk4x6Dim3rmQN2zoLaR3PNR0roU4/edit#heading=h.9q8y041ff7gr]the full guide[/url].


[h2][u]UPDATE DETAILS[/u][/h2]

[b]The game is all-in-one [/b]- Creativerse now runs entirely on your computer!
[list]
[*]Worlds are created and stored on your PC
[list]
[*]Playful hosted worlds can be migrated to your PC
[*]World templates are now hosted on mod.io and will be automatically downloaded as needed
[*]The game automatically performs world backups at regular intervals
[*]Local world data location: C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\PlayfulCorp\CreativerseServer\worlddata\worlds
[/list]
[*]New main menu options
[list]
[*]PLAY – opens the server browser, world creation form, and template viewer
[*]MIGRATE – new tool for transferring Playful hosted worlds to your local machine
[list]
[*]After you have migrated a world you need to switch back to the PLAY menu, go to the Local Servers tab and launch the world you have migrated
[*]You will be able to migrate any worlds you own
[*]You can also make your Playful hosted worlds available for others to migrate by editing the description to include “#migrationallowed”
[/list][/list]
[*]New customization options when creating worlds
[list]
[*]More than 2 dozen new world templates have been added
[*]Choose your world template from a new template gallery viewer
[*]Options to fine tune damage, gravity, stamina, ability cooldowns, spawn rates, claim costs, and more
[*]Option to turn on holiday events
[*]Additional options (e.g. timer and mining speeds) tweakable via config file in local world folder (config_world.json)
[/list]
[*]Multiplayer is now player hosted
[list]
[*]Host your own custom worlds
[*]Join worlds hosted by your Steam friends
[*]Find public worlds to join via Steam’s server list
[*]Note: hosting locally behind a LAN router requires port forwarding
[list]
[*]Default ports to forward (customizable): 26900, 26901 and 26902
[*]If customizing the port: only the base game port can be specified; the other two ports will be just the base port +1 and +2
[*]Instructions for port forwarding vary based on your router but here’s a general how-to: https://www.noip.com/support/knowledgebase/general-port-forwarding-guide/
[/list]
[*]More instructions can be found in [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rAeuk7qFinUyPRJGk4x6Dim3rmQN2zoLaR3PNR0roU4/edit#heading=h.12msrpnr8lve]our full guide[/url]
[/list][/list]
[b]In-game store removed[/b]
[list]
[*] Premium recipes are now unlocked via the crafting tree
[*] Premium consumables (QBits, Rocket Fuel) are now earned via quest rewards, spawned treasure, and mob drops
[*] Costumes can now be purchased with QBits in the character customization tool
[*] Costumes and player customization are now world-bound instead of account-bound
[*] All Creativerse Pro perks are enabled by default
[/list]
[b]Design improvements [/b]- Overall pass on player progression to streamline everything that’s been added over the years
[list]
[*]New progression tiers
[list]
[*]Wood, with new gauntlet
[*]Stone, with new armor set
[/list]
[*]Streamlined crafting, recipes, and unlocks for most items
[*]Quests have been simplified to reinforce but not compete with core progression
[list]
[*]Existing badges and perks have been reassigned to the new streamlined quest line.
[/list]
[*]Combat stat rebalancing
[list]
[*]Weapon, armor, mob HP, attack, damage, and explosive values have been fine-tuned
[/list]
[*]Loot rebalancing
[list]
[*]Updated loot for all treasure chests, mob drops and ranching rewards
[list]
[*]Includes newly-added unique loot tables for all variant mobs (e.g. Night Leafi, Corrupted Miru, etc.)
[/list]
[*]Mob loot includes a few new unique drops for updated recipes
[*]Treasure and ranching loot have been updated
[*]Premium consumables (Qbits, Rocket Fuel) are now obtained via loot tables
[/list]
[*]Updated mob spawn conditions to push biome identity, uniqueness, and utility
[*]New mob variants to add life to under-served biomes and serve rebalanced recipes
[list]
[*]Twiggy (daytime variant)
[*]Truffl (Red, Brown, and Glowing)
[*]Night and Corrupted Baby Leafi
[*]Frosty Leafi
[*]Snowfury (Dustevil's cold cousin)
[*]Swamp Trog
[*]Night Pebble
[/list]
[*] New weapons (found in treasure chests)
[list]
[*] Fire sword
[*] Ice sword
[/list][/list]
[b]Mailbox[/b] - ability to send messages to other players who’ve joined a world
[list]
[*] New mailbox item now available for sending messages to other players in a world
[*] Craft and place on the ground to interact with messaging
[*] Get the mailbox from the crafting list under Machines or search for it in the Creator menu
[*] Privacy note: messages are not secure and are viewable by world owners via the web admin
[/list]
[b]Web admin interface[/b] - allows additional management for world owners
[list]
[*] Allows player management in your world
[*] Includes a map view with ability to view claims and pets by player
[*] Ability to rollback world to an older backup
[*] Options to customize the Qbit cost of costumes
[*] To view admin tool, open this link in a browser while your world is running (world must be running on the same PC): 
[list]
[*] http://127.0.0.1:26902/admin/admin.html 
[*] Note: if you customized your world port, you’ll need to change the number after the colon, which will be two ports higher than your custom port
[*] For example: If you’re using base port 9000, the web admin would be: http://127.0.0.1:9002/admin/admin.html
[/list][/list]
[b]New blocks and items[/b]
[list]
[*]Nearly 300 new blocks and items have added
[*]Some are brand new, e.g. a new canvas set that is affected by both paint colors (search for "paint mix" by text)
[*]Others fill in the gap of missing variants of existing blocks, e.g. slabs, slopes, stairs, columns, eighths, corners
[*]All roofs now have a corresponding “full cube” version
[*]New variants are created using the Processor via the following workflow:
[list]
[*]Full blocks >
[list]
[*]Slabs > Slices
[*]Slopes, roofs, and stairs > Inner/outer corners
[*]Columns > Quarter Rounds
[/list][/list][/list]
[b]Visual improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Re-rendering of all template map images—they are now 100% prettier!
[*]Mask improvements for many blocks, e.g. snowflake glasses, plants
[*]Some blocks have reduced visibility in the dark, e.g. holiday garland, industrial gear, industrial LED, some gingerbread blocks
[*]All blocks now use both primary and secondary colors, e.g. death statue, goo cauldrons, gold blocks
[*]Some blocks that were too dark or that caused nearby blocks to become darker (regardless of painting) have been tweaked not to “cast darkness” anymore, e.g. the hotel jabot, the wooden and clay planters, many doors
[*]Some blocks that weren’t affected by artificial lights now either get affected properly, e.g the arc vault
[*]Overall paint strength slightly lowered to be closer to the tone of the natural blocks (you can still go full neon with glowing paint)
[*]Paint intensity has been further tweaked for more consistency when using the same paint, e.g. peakstone, dirt, grass sets
[*]Glass block mask now allows painting in full
[*]Option to remove blur filter for pixelated look [chat command? settings?)
[list]
[*]Command: /pref texturefiltermode 0
[*]Toggle off: /pref texturefiltermode 1
[/list]
[*]Additional tweaks to further improve block and item visuals
[/list]
[b]Additional improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Max view radius distance increased from 16 to 24 (note: may cause performance issues on older PCs)
[*]Improved in-game player management tools
[*]Improved world editing tools
[*]Replaced world password with whitelisting system
[*]Template picker and gallery showing the actual preview of the template/map
[*]Multiplayer:
[list]
[*]Ability to create direct connections to worlds that aren't announced in the lists
[*]Ability to use domain names instead of IP addresses when creating direct connections
[/list]
[*]Web admin alpha features (aka very WIP):
[list]
[*]Quest editing for creating custom quests
[*]Reference tool with detailed info about all blocks and items
[*]Procedurally generate very simple custom world templates
[/list][/list]

notes.title: Creativerse's Next Chapter
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/875e3652b4aeeb7aac564a8150694a5afda2e135.png[/img]
[h2][i]Update: we are delaying the new version a couple weeks for a bit more polish and bug fixes. We want your first impression of this new version to be as good as possible. ETA early December![/i][/h2]

[h2]Big changes are coming to Creativerse! [/h2]
[h3][i]The short version[/i]: next month, we're moving away from the free-to-play, Playful-hosted model to a pay-once, player-hosted version of Creativerse. This will allow us to give y'all a more customizable game that you have much more control over, and it will free up hosting costs that we can put toward future development. And [b]if you've spent any money on the game, you will get this new version for free![/b][/h3]

[i]The long version[/i]: In the spring of 1862, a traveling theater troupe arrived on the outskirts of Cincinnati and...wait, that's maybe too long.

[i]The less long version[/i]: More than 8 years ago, we debuted Creativerse as an early access game on Steam. Within a few months it had organically become a hit with YouTubers, getting featured by InTheLittleWood, Biffa, Slipg8r, Gronkh, and many others. It was the beginning of an amazing journey. Ever since, Creativerse has been a relatively successful game, maintaining a player base and a consistent monthly revenue most studios could only dream of.

Despite this, outside of one exception Creativerse has never been profitable. Its year over year costs always exceeded what it brought in. We spent years trying to solve this issue, and occasionally we'd see some promising spikes, but they never lasted.

That one exception? It was during the first 15 months of early access, when the game was not yet free to play. Going F2P was our plan from the get go—we were open about this and charged $20 upfront as a way to help fund the game during its first year or so. As it turned out, Creativerse's business model just worked better as a pay-once game.

Getting to the bottom of why F2P isn't a good fit for Creativerse is too complex for a "less long" version of the story. There are a lot of reasons. To keep it simple I'll focus on one: costs. They fall under 2 categories, development and live-ops. Development is the stuff you see in our patch notes—new features and content, bug fixes, improvements, fun stuff like that.

Live-ops is all the behind-the-scenes stuff we do to enable the game's built-in multiplayer. Our players have created hundreds of thousands of worlds over the years, and Playful hosts all of it. We pay to store that data, as well as run an API and server agents that spin up worlds when players join them, and a host of other services that do everything from logging errors to optimizing our server architecture. We also have to fix servers when they go down and keep up with changes to the way third-party services run things (something they're frequently doing). Also, because Creativerse is a free-to-play game, there’s even live-ops costs hidden in our development budget in the form of us spending time making content and features that keep monetization going, which eats into time we can spend on features that are equally cool but might have a less direct impact on paying the bills.

In other words, a big chunk of the game's budget goes toward live-ops. What if instead, we used that budget solely for development costs?

I want to take a moment to acknowledge that we haven't always been able to support Creativerse as much as we would have liked over the past few years. There have been times where y’all would be waiting for months or longer for an update. Our last update was over a year ago. I wish this weren't the case but riding out the pandemic and some big changes at the studio kept us from being able to focus on Creativerse the way we would have preferred.

This is why, starting last year, we began work on a new version of the game. And now, in 4 weeks, we will "re-release" Creativerse as a pay-once-play-forever game. It will run as a complete executable on your local PC, with the client, server, and data all in one package, and all the free-to-play elements removed (store, coins, etc). We will call it...

[h2]“Creativerse: The Definitive Edition”[/h2]

Giving up the built-in multiplayer is a big sacrifice, but not having the costs and hassle of running it as a game-as-a-service will give us—and you—way more flexibility. Like, when the entire game runs on your machine and we don't have to worry about F2P? We can make nearly everything customizable. Want a world with infinite stamina, a 1 second timer on all processor materials, one-hit kills on all mobs, and holiday events turned on year-round? Done. Want under-the-hood options for managing a server, its players, and backups? You got it. In fact, if this pivot proves successful, we could add support for even wilder stuff like mods. Also, there will still be multiplayer and a list of public worlds to join in the game—it’ll just be up to players to set up and host.

The Definitive Edition launches on Nov 15, 2022. Here's what you need to know....

 — It will retail for $24.99. HOWEVER, anyone who has spent any money on the game—whether DLC or coins or early access—[b]will get it for free![/b]

 — If you haven't spent money on the game as of today, you have until the re-launch to purchase a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/515710/Creativerse__Pro/]now discounted Pro DLC[/url] that includes it (i.e. this is $10 cheaper than it will be after Nov 15).

 — You will be able to download—or “migrate”—your own worlds from our servers for 90 days following the re-release. You can also whitelist any world you own so other players can migrate it.

 — The new version will include: [list]
[*] A TON of new customization options
[*] Tools for hosting your own multiplayer worlds
[*] New and improved player progression path, with streamlined unlocks, recipes, quests, and premium consumables like Qbits and Costumes added to core gameplay rewards
[*] More than 300 new blocks and items, new mob variants, a “mailbox” item for sending messages to other players in your world, improved admin tools for managing worlds, visual improvements, and more
[/list]
We’ll be sharing more details over the next few weeks. In the meantime, please share your feedback with us here or on [url=https://discord.gg/creativerse]Discord[/url]!

—PlayfulDavid

notes.title: The People’s Build-Off: Morning vs. Night
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/1d02b9693f97a693f242826ec495713131dfad64.png[/img]
Hello Creators!!

Work is still underway on one of our biggest updates yet. I can’t wait to share more details with you next month!

In the meantime, we have a question for you…

[h2]Are you a morning person or a night person?[/h2]

I’m gonna be honest. I never knew how to answer that question. Are you talking about when I’m most likely to be awake? Productive? Susceptible to bad decisions? 

While the morning / night person question may not be a good prompt for chit chat, it’s a great one for a Creativerse build-off! And we’re gonna make it interesting: we will be declaring a winner in the battle of Morning People vs. Night People based on the number of entries received. Only one team can win. Will you be #TeamMorning or #TeamNight? I wanna see a real battle for the soul of our earth’s rotation around its vertical axis. 

Here’s how it’ll work...

Like our last contest, this one asks you to answer a question about yourself with a screenshot from Creativerse: are you a morning person or a night person?

The way you chose to answer that question is up to you. There are no wrong answers. You don’t even have to explain yourself. Just include [b]#TeamMorning [/b]or [b]#TeamNight [/b]in the description field (or title) of your submission on our Steam Artwork hub. We’ll let Entuland’s script that sniffs out hashtags, and with it the cold, unimpeachable voice of your collective raw data, take it from there. We will determine once and for all the people’s choice for the superior position of the sun!

Who will win? Night people? Morning people? Frankly the stakes have never been higher.

Regardless of which team wins, [i]everyone[/i] who participates will be rewarded with 5 Qbits and 5 Villagers. And ten of you who post our favorite screenshots (criteria defined below) will receive a bonus prize: 300 coins and the rare, elusive Trophy Gauntlet set. That’s 3 custom gauntlet skins—Bronze, Silver, and Gold—not available in the store. 

Good luck, humanity!

–PlayfulDavid [url=https://twitter.com/DavidRCalkins]ːgolemyayː[/url]


[u][b]Details[/b][/u]

[b]Duration[/b]: now through August 16, 2021 at noon Central US time.

[b]Entry[/b]: 
[list]
[*] Post your screenshot in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/images/]Artwork[/url] on our Steam hub
[*] Include either [b]#[u]TeamMorning[/u][/b] or [u][b]#TeamNight[/b][/u] in the description or title
[*] (Optional) Add a Workshop link to any blueprints shown, if applicable
[/list]

[b]How to screenshot[/b]:
[list]
[*] The tilde key (~) -- aka the BackTick key (`) -- will bring up the Creative Cam
[*] (Optional) Use the onscreen tools to customize the look
[*] Press F to save a screenshot to your desktop
[*] For more help, see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/discussions/3/1643178512746153188/?snr=2_9_100003_]Shiva’s guide[/url]
[/list]

[b]Prizes[/b]: 
[list]
[*] All participants: pack of 5 Qbits and 5 Programmable Villagers
[*] Ten prize winners (5 for #TeamMorning and 5 for #TeamNight): 300 coins, and the [url=https://creativerse.fandom.com/wiki/Gold_Gauntlet]Trophy Gauntlet[/url] set, including Gold, Silver, and Bronze
[/list]

[b]Prize winner criteria[/b]: 
[list]
[*] Scale and epicness of build or “found” shot
[*] Uniqueness and variety of blocks/items in shot
[*] Creative Camera tool mastery (e.g. just the right amount of fog and bloom)
[/list]

[b]Rules[/b]: 
[list]
[*] The screenshot must feature original work created by you
[*] UNLESS: it’s a shot of something found in your default world template
[*] This includes any blueprints used in the shot
[*] You can enter multiple times...but only win once
[*] Mods and Playful employees are welcome to participate but ineligible to be one of the 10 bonus prize winners.
[/list]

[b]Winners will be announced (and prizes awarded) on or before August 20, 2021.[/b]

[b]Final thoughts[/b]:
Seriously y’all, thanks in advance for participating! These are a ton of fun. And this time we’ll obtain the people’s definitive, legally-binding, epoch-defining answer to an extremely important question!!

[i]P.S. Our lawyer asked us to clarify that the previous sentence was a joke. To which we laughed maniacally for eleven uninterrupted minutes. But seriously, we’re joking. Including the part about talking to a lawyer.[/i]

As a reward to all of you wonderful Creators, we have a promo code to receive 25 Qbits for free! Enter the code YARRR in the store to claim it. Perhaps one of the many majestic ships found in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=280790&searchtext=ship]workshop[/url] to go with your new pirate outfit?

notes.title: WINNERS of the Inside / Outside Build-Off
notes.notes:
Y’all. 

These entries were so good.

Last month, we asked you to tell us whether you were an indoor or outdoor person, and you rose to the occasion by submitting some of our favorite Creativerse screenshots ever. It’s always hard to pick the winners, but this one was especially challenging.

As it turns out, a lot of you are outside people. In fact, there were so many outside entries that we quickly realized we couldn’t do justice to the build-off without adding a third category: Found Shots. These are outdoor shots that were cool but mostly untouched from the original world template.

That makes a total of 15 winners: 5 outdoor shots, 5 indoor shots, and 5 found outdoors shots. Here they are...

[h2][u]Outside[/u][/h2]

[h3]A1WEND1L - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2496201588]Isle of the Purple Pagoda[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/93662710378bbbcb1e734cfafb59c5c1ba274838.jpg[/img]
Pinch me, I'm dreaming. Seriously, I had to do a double take with this one. [i]"Is that actually Creativerse?"[/i] It is. It's also a masterclass in building, shot composition, and use of color.

[h3]Mordred - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2496706716]Minnie's haberdashery[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/21686b04022db5e29851ac022172d4e1cda769a5.jpg[/img]
Mordred came in 2nd for most entries submitted (congrats A1WEND1L for 1st), but that's cool -- we enjoyed every one of them. Especially this glorious shot from their series paying homage to Quentin Tarantino.

[h3]RSoM LuckySheep - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2508886583]Sir Marvin the Turtle's Magnificent Ambulatory Observatorium[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/b2acd9b698b5d4c10a761424f10bee27478ebce1.jpg[/img]
I have no idea what otherworldly wizardry Sir Marvin and his friends get up to, but whatever it is, I would like to know more dot gif. RSoM LuckySheep can play the creative cam like Miles Davis played the trumpet.

[h3]Iggdrasil - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2496178809]Human Fortress - Square[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/838ac454ccc64f75d563e3bed2b46503b66cc721.jpg[/img]
I've seen a lot of castle builds over the years, so it takes a lot to raise my eyebrow at another one, but I love the framing here, as well as the seamless blending with a mountain. The design is cool, and all that reinforced iron makes me feel like I'd have a fighting chance against a horde of invading Things.

[h3]soaringfreedom - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2484249556]main street HOGS HEAD TOWN[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/8c7ecc5d0df3ab54e770b5d20372689f84c8bf8f.jpg[/img]
The mix of intimate detail and grand scale in this one is magical: the way the horizon draws the eye inward, from the detailed outer edges to the vast horizon that shrinks to a teeny dot in a rule of thirds sweet spot...[i]chef's kiss[/i]


[h2][u]Inside[/u][/h2]

[h3]omarajbere31766 - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2507622923]Inside the Cave of Wonders[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/407d331900b517be5d8ce331e8c15a11fd421cc5.jpg[/img]
This one is deceptively simple, but I love the use of color. I also love omarajbere's intriguing description: [i]"Take a cave or cavern. Place all different styles of lights about it and put a lot of ice or snow on the ceiling and alternately throw fire bombs and freeze bombs at it and see what happens."[/i] What happens!? I must know!

[h3]єäяєɴd3ℓ - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2493841936]Salon Fantaisie[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/5b43a61e417c3df7d6bb81bb3b0b46742f77071e.jpg[/img]
єäяєɴd3ℓ submitted a whole bunch of amazing shots, but I love the in-game items to arc sign pixel art ratio in this. I also want to go to there. You can build it yourself with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2441124438]this awesome blueprint[/url].

[h3]AlexStudio - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2491419587]Дося in home[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/b595c0e3ca42d053739970c1d7feb5fbd1dfd7bd.jpg[/img]
This is like a really well done selfie but in Creativerse. I feel like I know a lot about this character that AlexStudio's created. Actually scratch that, all I know is they have good taste and an enigmatic energy that intrigues me.

[h3]CILOOR - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2509936325]INSIDE THE HOUSE[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/e6252b41b5b412a2ccf106f4405df4cb3e059af4.jpg[/img]
I've always been skeptical of the border effect in the creative cam (which sometimes looks like what I call "ugly borderlands") but this has convinced me it can be great. The lighting, block choices, and filters all come together for a really cozy but unique interior. Build it yourself with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2483765523&searchtext=simple+house]this blueprint[/url].

[h3]Hororogoro - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2483372877]In the Library[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/08cf4b8102b20d9bc04403c6f29ad7bd8de84956.jpg[/img]
The FOV slider in the creative cam can get pretty crazy, but this is the perfect use of sliding it up to 11. There's so much detail packed in, and the edges are far enough away that they don't look super warped. This looks like a nice place to feel guilty about not reading a book while I browse my phone.


[h2][u]Outside (Found)[/u][/h2]

[h3]Rebecca - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2482094189]Gliding through the skies[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/2b876f6b52a918b8e1b77268bdff561e58670747.jpg[/img]
If you've ever tried to capture an action shot of other players doing cool stuff (or in my case, footage for the game's trailer captured from 3 computers using both hands and my foot), you know how hard it can be. Epic shot!

[h3]Mirky - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2483108485]Exploiting Mother Nature[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/8115d554504c3a228fb75deb2c7d01dce2287a98.jpg[/img]
I like this one a lot. I almost didn't pick it because...well, it's a visual glitch. But Entuland convinced me: [i]"Clever play of the 'inside' part of the theme, this is a shot taken from inside the terrain, exploiting the see-through when you are looking at textures from the 'wrong end.'"[/i] Also it looks cool.

[h3]Livia - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2481319939]Leafi Mountain for the Inside Outside event[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/cba563326cc1d687213d352e01d2862dcaba1f2f.jpg[/img]
I can totally see Leafi in there. From the description: [i]"There are two rivers coming out of his eye's like tears so I called them Leafi Tear River."[/i] Packaging a fun idea along with a striking shot makes this landscape pic a winner.

[h3]GG - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2484685674]The Secret Cave - Outside[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/6063aceba9e98584ce6402588e54dd5be95c1c01.jpg[/img]
It's a great shot of a great spot in a great game. I love it!

[h3]Schatten - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2480324949]#insideoutsed #coldbutterflies[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/07192158d833ad3c23f90830f10765034ed747c7.jpg[/img]
The technical limitations of the game's draw distance sometimes distracts from an otherwise great shot (speaking of which, we're looking at adding fog to obscure the jagged edges of unloaded chunks). This shot, however, uses that limitation to its benefit, making the world look like it's a tiny planet you could circumnavigate on a day hike.

notes.title: The Build-a-Buddy Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/a38add28d4e0e56803ff75eb9e087ed2adc044aa.png[/img]

Hello Creators!

There’s been a lot of commotion in the Creativerse universe in the past few months… We have welcomed the arrivals of Baby Leafi, Petey the Parroki, Buzzkill, butterflies, and many more to Creativerse with curiosity. The world feels more friendly.  

If you followed our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/280790/announcements/detail/2914347411515310260]weekend build challenge[/url], you may have heard about the mysterious friendly traveller who sent letters out through the Pebble Postal Service asking if they could visit. Until today, their identities have been unknown…

We call them Villagers! While they aren't the first non-player characters to appear in Creativerse (shout out to Pumpkiru and Elfi), these friendly folks have some powerful surprises in store for you. They are out there now, in the world, waiting for you to find them. They each have their own favorite hangout spots, so you'll have to go looking for them. Once found, they will present you with a challenge. Upon completion, you will be granted a most curious reward: Programmable Villagers, which are customizable NPCs you can place anywhere you like! Villagers are eager to become extant and fill your creations with life, and they each have their own unique quirks, tastes, and things to share.

As always, we look forward to your feedback!

Happy building!
[i]
—The Playful Team[/i]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*] [b]Villagers[/b] have arrived![list][*]Villagers are helpful, customizable, interactable NPC friends-in-waiting.[*]Villagers have jobs that define their behavior.[/list][list][list][*] You'll have one villager job unlocked by default: [b]Talker[/b][*] Additional jobs, like Miner or Logger, can be permanently unlocked by:[/list][/list][list][list][list][*] Collecting Villager Upgrade Chips from treasure chests.
[*] Finding villagers in the wild and helping them.
[/list][/list][/list][list][list][list][list]
[*] Villagers will spawn in various locations, depending on their assigned job.
[*] Villagers will ask you for help with a certain task. If you can complete their task, you'll permanently unlock that villager's job, and receive a Programmable Villager to use anywhere!
[/list][/list][/list][/list][/list][list][list][*] New item: Programmable Villager[olist]
[*] Programmable Villagers can be placed anywhere and assigned a job to perform.

notes.title: Weekend Event — The Creativerse Hospitality Challenge
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/3005c54fc08a9f0eee72220a2f4c93676dc07473.jpg[/img]

Hello Creators!

Word has gotten out about our awesome universe… In the past few months, our world has welcomed the arrivals of Baby Leafi, Petey the Parroki, Buzzkill, and all the new faces in Creativerse! And your world, Creator, has become very popular to new visitors. In fact, we’ve been getting letters from another very friendly traveler who wishes to visit Creativerse and see what all the hype is about. It seems our reputation precedes us!

The letter, sent via the ever trusty Pebble Postal Service, reads:

[i]Hello Creator! 

I am new to this world and looking for a place to call home! Though I would not like to impose, I was wondering if you had any space available in your world. Looking for an inviting town, village, or cave where I can settle into my craft. Hmm, village has a nice ring to it...

Do you have a place for me?

-Name unknown

Sent via Pebble Postal Service, First Class [/i]
____

Well, Creators. It appears our task for the week is clear! 

[b]The challenge: [/b]Build a cozy guest home and suitable workspace for our guest: feel free to use any and all blocks available to you. There is no limit to Creativerse hospitality!

Once you’ve created the perfect room and board, share a screenshot on our Steam hub, either in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/images/]Artwork[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/screenshots/]Screenshots [/url](pro tip: Artwork images can end up as loading screens in the game). Important: make sure you include[i] #NeedyGuest [/i]in the image description.

[b]Submit by 9/8/2020, 2 PM CST.[/b]
You’ll be awarded [b]150 coins[/b] for your hospitality efforts! 

We’d like to send the guest images from your creation so the Pebble Post isn’t overwhelmed. They’re very friendly but also very keen to keep sending letters until we respond. It’s like they have no mind of their own!



[i]—The Playful Welcome Team
[/i]

notes.title: Petey’s Eggsquisite Kitchen Kraze Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/f3751cef7bc57acdb1400974e100469d5e933405.jpg[/img]

The perfect skillet. Sunday Roast. Toast! Does this deliciousness strike your fancy? In the past few updates, we’ve gone into a bit of a frenzy cooking up new ways to spruce up your Creativerse homes with bathrooms and gardens, so it’s only logical that the kitchen came next. [i]Also, we were hungry.
[/i]

The Better Homes department has a tantalizing assortment of Sunday Brunch accoutrement, including a kitchen sink and refrigerator, both of which act as displays, an oven range that doubles as a cooking station, a coffee maker that gives you a burst of energy, a Heavenly Baked Hog that’s not only delicious but 100% calorie free. That’s not even the half of it — just scroll down to the patch notes and see what we mean. The wildest part? It’s all available in a bundle that is completely FREE ([i]for a limited time[/i]). 

This update’s mascot is [b]Egghead,[/b] with whom you can delight and/or terrorize your friends with by picking up the outfit in the store. It’s perhaps an unconventional costume, but 2020 has been an unconventional year and we’re responding in kind. While you’re there you can pick up the Skillful Skillet, a weapon and frying pan all in one. Just be sure not to crack up while wearing the Egghead. You may end up as breakfast.

This update’s sidekick mascot is [b]Petey,[/b] a new companion that you all [url=https://twitter.com/creativersegame/status/1272956255544451072]voted on[/url] (if you didn’t, you need to follow us on social media more). Petey may be domesticated, but his wild counterparts from the Parroki genus aren’t, so keep an eye out for them. They’ll be spawning in a world near you.
[i]
—The Playful Team [/i]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/8617fe997970380b40207d6cfadc475f1ea2e9e8.png[/img]


Creators, there’s nothing more relaxing than gardening. We love it so much we are making a party out of it (so, the opposite of relaxing). 

This blooming, groovin’ Garden Party Update has[i] everything[/i]: critters, pots, plants, even a pretty dangerous shovel called Dirtslayer. You can already smell the flowers, like the Prickly Pal Cactus Plant or the succulent plant, filling up your worlds with the pure scent of life itself. No previous gardening experience required. 

And of course, we can’t have plants without bees and butterflies! Along with your gardener’s essentials, we’ve added new ambient insects to the world, as well as the cutest companion you ever did see: Buzzkill. Just don’t get on his bad side. 

For advanced you Creators, we’ve added four new machines to this update, including tools to make teleporting and chest access easier as well as an inventory sensor and a “math gate”. Can’t wait to see how y'all put those to use! Maybe a perilous garden maze adventure? Just thinking out loud...

Happy building!

[i]—The Playful Team [/i]

notes.title: The Arrival Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/95822f3f428d9c3599fa9d385128ade2af2aa78a.jpg[/img]

More strange glitches have appeared across the Creativerse skies, and with them, new Creators have materialized. The latest sighting was of a tall figure covered in otherworldly armor who was recently seen hovering in the sky near the quaint town of Pebblington. They (or it?) were accompanied by a creature resembling a Leafi, but much smaller and, if you can believe it, even cuter. The appearance of this creature seems to have made a powerful impact on the Creativerse biome, as now copies of it can be seen spawning all over the place.

This update also brings two big new features. The flashier of the two are [b]Rocket Packs[/b], which when equipped will send you hurling to great heights and protect you from fall damage. Rocket Packs can be collected from your daily login reward, or grab a bunch from the store — and the first pack is on us!

The sleeper hit of this update is the new [b]Arc Vault system[/b], a second inventory that is account-bound and will follow you across worlds and servers. You can access it by crafting and placing an Arc Vault in your world. Anything stored there will show up in Arc Vaults crafted in other worlds, allowing you to take blocks, tools, decor, and anything else wherever you go in the Creativerse. 

We hope you enjoy and look forward to your feedback!

[i]—The Playful Team  (& K.E.E.P.A.)[/i]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/482b5db62a2501ebeb04c803d1106f7c6cd142ae.jpg[/img]

Times are strange. By now, you and your critters may be feeling a bit cooped up. And man, we get the feeling. 

The best thing to do is to make things a bit cozier, a bit “homier”. And what is more “homey” than a care package?


Inspired by our need for a taste of “normal”, the team put together an assortment of self-care goodies: a bath to soak in, a new Galactic Gamer Monitor to upgrade your rig, tasty cans of Rambrew soda to quench your thirst… And, knowing how hard it is to get in the “real world”, we actually have a few rolls of toilet paper.  Feel like sharing AND letting out some frustration?  Throw some at your neighbor ([i]Six-Feet away of course[/i])... if you hit them, they can keep it.  After all, sharing is caring!

Along with bug fixes, the team wanted to send you this two part Cozy Care package, with love.  What's more, we want to make it FREE to everyone for a limited time.
Consider it an in-between gift, while you wait on an arrival…

We hope you find something you like!

notes.title: Weekend Event: Group Photo Celebration!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/577f213522beaec6e0f61c8af4b0ef281b0658d6.png[/img]
[h3]At Playful, we've always believed in the power of video games to bring people together. 
[/h3]
As people around the world remain at home to combat the spread of COVID-19, online gaming has become a haven for people to gather while also practicing social distancing. We proudly support the World Health Organization's #PlayApartTogether initiative, and this weekend we're celebrating with a group photo event in Creativerse!

To participate, just gather online with some friends and use the Creative Cam drone tool to snap the perfect photo of the group. Then post it to our Steam hub — either [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/screenshots/]Screenshots [/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/images/]Artwork[/url] — and include #PlayApartTogether in the photo's description. 

[b]All Creators appearing in the photo will earn 100 coins![/b]

[i][b]Important note[/b][/i]: to make sure everyone is rewarded, please include the Steam ID for each player in the photo's description. You can find it in the last string of characters that appears in the URL for your profile page. For example...

[noparse]https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/[u][b]76561198132431015[/b][/u]/[/noparse]
[noparse]https://steamcommunity.com/id/[u][b]playfuldavid[/b][/u][/noparse]

Some event tips:[list]
[*] Type "/hud" in chat before turning on the Creative Cam for a text-free shot
[*] Type "~" to open the Creative Cam and then "O" to switch to Drone mode
[*] In Drone mode hit right "Alt" to toggle the filters panel
[*] When ready type "F" to save a photo to your desktop
[*] Don't have any friends who play Creativerse currently? Make some new ones in a Public world or our [url=https://discord.gg/creativerse]Discord server[/url].
[/list]

Some IRL tips:[list]
[*] Wash Your Hands
[*] Cover Your Cough
[*] Don't touch your face
[*] Stay 6 feet apart
[*] Stay Home
[/list]

The event is live right now and ends at 9am Central US time on Tuesday, April 14.

Have fun and stay safe!

[i]Photo credit: Paws of Ares[/i]

notes.title: The Super Block Hero Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/b31c932622b8a877ddfd6faf809f8f7047977aaf.jpg[/img]

Somewhere deep in the great lands of Creativerse, beyond the Miru forests, Leafi plainlands, and even further beyond the Trog mountains, a giant PING broke into the atmosphere. For a moment, all Creators went quiet, for they had never before heard such a sound before…

Where did it come from?[i] Why did they get the sudden craving for Duck Hunt and hairspray? [/i]

Little did they know, this was the Great Glitch—a random mishap ushering in strange blocks and props, and even a different kind of Creator (more into New Wave music and velcro, you see). The arrivals called themselves, Supers. Creators called them Blocky. After some negotiations, it was decided the Super Block Heroes were welcome to stay in the hopes they would bring forth new creations, new art, and new possibilities. After all, you know what they say…what’s old is new again!

In addition to the arrival of the Super Block Heroes, this update also includes a Unity upgrade! This should immediately relieve some of the constant stuttering many of you have reported and allow us to more easily improve it even further down the road.

As always, we thank you for your continued support and feedback!

— The Playful Team

notes.title: Creativity: Evolved — Creativerse R63
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/c3a6f1c971cd89b8dd6df59c9a793f2c4506d427.jpg[/img]

This is a big one. And it’s long overdue. But it’s finally here!

In keeping with our tradition of making a game for the community, this update contains some of our all-time most requested features, all geared toward unlocking the game’s full creative potential.
[olist]
[*]Creative Worlds — A new kind of world where you can fly, hover, and get an infinite supply of every item in the game.
[*]Paintable Blocks — You can now customize the color of any block or item and create swatches to quickly change the look of your builds.
[*]Creative Camera — A full suite of filters and visual tools, including a detachable drone camera for getting epic shots of your builds.
[/olist]
Another popular request has come from players near and dear to our heart: Creativerse Pro members. They’ve repeatedly asked us to add more features to the Pro version. In this update we are increasing the value of Pro in two ways: 1) While anyone can join a Creative World, only Pro members can create and customize them. 2) Pro members now get discounts on everything in the store. In fact, many of the premium recipe blocks are currently FREE for Pro members.

The future is bright for Creativerse. This update is just the start. We have exciting plans and a ton of content in the pipeline. Thank you for being on this journey with us!

<3 The Playful Team

[h2]New Features and Content[/h2]
[h3]Creative Worlds[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unlimited items! The sky is literally the limit
[*] Hover Ability! Double tap the jump button to toggle hover mode
[*] Flat worlds! At world creation, choose “Flat Grass” or “Flat Sand” in the template drop down for a blank canvas experience
[*] Turn on Creator Mode while in a Creative World by pressing “ESC” and selecting “Enable Creator Mode” just above Game Settings (and repeat the process to toggle back to “adventure” mode)
[*] While in Creator Mode...
[list]
[*] Your inventory and “adventure” quickbar are replaced by an all-item selection menu and a “creative” quickbar
[*] You cannot equip a weapon; however mobs will ignore you regardless of world settings 
[*] Toggle back to “adventure” mode to do things like moving your touchstone or attacking mobs
[/list]
[*] World owners can decide whether to grant Creator Mode to all players, specific players, or tie its access to a permissions level (e.g. admins only)
[*] Creating and customizing Creative Worlds is an exclusive Creativerse Pro feature
[*] Not a Pro member? You can still access the Creator Mode features by playing in someone else’s Creative World
[/list]

[h3]Paintable Blocks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Change the color of every block and item that can be placed in the world, including lights and even smoke
[*] Build customized swatches, with the option to designate a primary and secondary color (press “.” to open swatch builder)
[*] Add your swatches to a paint quickbar to quickly switch between colors while playing (hold “Ctrl” to open quickbar)
[*] With a swatch selected, blocks will be painted as you place them; or you can hold “Ctrl” and left mouse click to paint already placed or found blocks
[*] Blueprint capture blocks will retain your custom paint settings
[/list]

[h3]Creative Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*] Capture epic screenshots with new visual tools and filters (press “~” to toggle)
[list]
[*] Color settings (brightness, contrast, saturation)
[*] Fog control
[*] Bloom sliders
[*] Tilt shift
[*] Vignette effects
[*] And much more!
[/list]
[*] Player movement is possible in camera mode (press left “Alt” to toggle)
[*] Detachable drone camera (press “O” while in camera mode to toggle)
[list]
[*] Separate from your player character to get at impossible angles, clip through terrain, and channel your inner Roger Deakins
[*] Keyframe animation! While in drone mode, toggle back to Creative Camera (press left “Alt”) to access keyframe animation buttons
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]New Costumes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Monkey King Costume - Full Set
[*] Unicorn Costume - Full Set 
[*] Unicorn Sword (a cosmetic version of the elusive Rainbownator 5000)
[*] Emperor's Blade
[*] All existing costumes now have helmets!
[list]
[*] First Fantasy Helmet
[*] Master Creator Helmet
[*] Metal MK1 Helmet
[*] Electro Cycle Helmet
[*] Fury Warrior Helmet
[/list]
[/list]

[/list]
