notes.title: The Under the Hood Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Creators!
 
You may have noticed that the team has put out a steady stream of patches up until now, ironing out the wrinkles and swatting bugs left and right. Today's update is similar but on a bigger scale, with particular focus on optimizing the game's performance. This included an engine upgrade (Unity 2018), rebuilding old code, lots of tinkering and elbow grease, and extensive testing on the worst, most min-spec PCs we could find. As a result, the Under the Hood Update offers a smoother, more optimized experience, along with a bunch of smaller improvements and bugfixes. It’s certainly not the end of performance fixes, but it's a pretty good foundation for more.

	
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Updates, Additions, and Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Major Engine upgrade to Unity 2018[/b]
[list]
[*] Assorted bug fixes related to engine upgrade
[*] New graphics quality settings
[/list]
[*] Mud is now craftable using Water and Dirt
[*] Water no longer requires any mining cell to be pulled
[*] Max view radius has been increased
[*] Lava and Corrupted Water can now be pulled by Diamond mining cell
[*] Hidden Temple and Medieval Chests no longer require Stone mining cell to pull 
[*] Selection highlight in Action Bar is a little wider and easier to see
[*] Gift Boxes are rotatable in any direction
[*] Pet information window is simultaneously dismissed with its associated pet
[*] Lilly pads can now be put in containers
[*] Automatic text censoring logic has been improved to try and help reduce the number of false positives, i.e “Grass”
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pet bubbles render on top of water correctly
[*] Glowing mushrooms are glowing again
[*] Pets are properly dirty after harvesting (get the soap ready!)
[*] New adventures show up under the New category
[*] Fixed a few issues with Pets disappearing (i.e in some instances, pets that were told to “Stay” would either disappear or wind up clumped together)
[*] Fixed a few issues related to player names (such as when a user is banned)
[*] Decogorgeous Door disappears at the same distance as other doors
[*] Blocky the Snowman is visible when placed in a container
[*] Fixed snow caps spreading and showing up inconsistently (how rude!)
[*] Fixed issues related to recipes not carrying over between worlds properly
[*] Magic Snow Globe should no longer create snow when placed in displays
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented purchase of block kits for a moss block-customized blueprint
[*] All firework types give off sound effects
[*] Sleeping in a bed for the first time no longer triggers a “New Area Discovered” message/ reveals a grid on the map
[*] Mobs can now be attacked while they are in a teleporter
[*] Customizing Curtains no longer create error blocks around them
[*] Frozen Container no longer mysteriously hides itself after leaving and returning to an area
[*] /setspawn should work again
[*] @ and other symbols can now be correctly used in text fields regardless of the keyboard layout
[*] Safe walk now prevents players from walking off slopes
[*] Player preferences are now tied to your Steam account instead of the client
[/list]


From Jeremy:[i] "Small easter egg, when you save your costume customization in the menu, a high res screen of your character is saved to C:\Users\your user\AppData\LocalLow\PlayfulCorp\Creativerse\avatar[/i]

There is quite a lot of new stuff to show off. That got us thinking: what better way than to raise the bar than with some stylish screenshots?

[h1]Greetings, Creators![/h1]

Twas the weeks before the holidays, when all through Creativerse–[i]*record scratch*[/i] 

Troggington the Abominable Snow Trog stole all Elfi’s toys! Creators, we need your help to take back those presents and save Elfi’s Wonderland. 

Things aren’t all cloudy and gray. We’ve added a smorgasbord of festive items to brighten up your world. In fact, this may be our largest content update [b]ever.[/b] The simple task of writing these patch notes took forever because the team just kept adding more stuff. They may working on even more blocks right now. Who knows?

But the best part about this update isn’t a matter of what, but how. For the first time in Playful’s history, we are donating a portion of proceeds from the event’s duration to charity, specifically [b]The Make-A-Wish Foundation.[/b] That essentially makes this update a fundraiser to support making kids’ life-changing wishes come true. There are two ways you can contribute....

[list]
[*]Purchase our any of our new Elfi's Wonderland bundles from the Creativerse store. Each one comes with the same festive gift wrap block recipes, plus a ton of bonus toys and crafted blocks. Buy one or buy a bunch! 100% of the funds we receive from these bundles will go to Make-A-Wish!

Now the time has come for YOU to help him reclaim his delicious candies and fight off the ghastly hordes!

notes.title: [Closed] Official Contest – Creativerse Fan Art
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6567866/0c2e06b3c8839ecb49166395b5927d85a5da4a0e.jpg[/img]Hello there, Creators!

Welcome to the [b]Official Creativerse Fan Art Contest[/b]! We have seen some truly amazing Creativerse artwork from the community over the years and are excited for this chance to spotlight all of the talented and creative Creators out there. 

[u]The Challenge[/u]
Wow us with your insanely talented Creativerse fan art in whichever medium feels best.

[i]How?[/i]
Pick your medium of choice and make some magic happen. Whether it is charcoal, oil, photoshop, ink, markers, fabric, yarn, tattoo, mud…express yourself! Be creative!

[u]Duration[/u] 
Contest begins October 4, 2018 and will end November 2, 2018 at 11:59 AM Central Standard Time (That’s on a Friday for you calendar keeping folks).


[h1]Prizes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]GRAND PRIZE (5)[/b] – Five creators will receive the following...
[list]
[*]$50 Steam gift card
[*]Trophy gauntlet costume of your choosing: bronze, silver, gold
[*]3,000 coins 
[/list]

[*][b]RUNNER UP (10)[/b] – Ten creators will receive…
[list]
[*]Trophy gauntlet costume of your choosing: bronze, silver, gold
[*]2,000 coins
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]How to Enter[/h1]
1 – [b]Steam[/b]: upload up to THREE (3) images of your submission and reply to this post with the links. We like seeing awesome creations on our Steam Artwork Hub, but imgur or similar image hosting sites are fine, too.
2 – [b]Twitter or Instagram[/b]: upload up to THREE (3) photos/copies of your submission with your Creativerse username and the hashtag #creativersecontest.

[h1]How do I win?[/h1]
We will choose a variety of winners, from any medium, who blow us out of the water. Whether you are spotlighting extreme creativity, skill, or just a lot of heart, the main goal of this contest is creative expression. Sharing art is brave and epic, so color us dazzled! Awe us with your wonderful ink skills, terrify us with a Leafi robot sculpture (look out, Alexa), or delight us with a lumite castle cake. 
Creativity is the only key! And remember, the ultimate winner is all of us because we get to share and enjoy all of the heart and talent out there.

[i]I can’t art[/i]
Fan art contest not your jam? No worries! Rumor has it there is a good ol’ Creativerse building contest coming up, so stay tuned…

[h1]Rules & Restrictions[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Deadline for submitting your amazing art is Friday, November 2, 2018: 11:59 AM CST.
[*]All artwork and photography of artwork should be submitted in PNG or JPG form.
[*]Entries are still eligible if they have been created prior to the start of this contest.
[*]Screenshots from Creativerse are not eligible – entries must be created outside the game, whether physically (e.g. painting, quilting, sculpture) or digitally (e.g. photoshop/wacom drawing).
[*]The content of your submission must be your own creation.
[*]Limit one art entry per person.
[/list]

The Big Update has a little brother: The Medium Update, and his pockets are lined with some nice improvements and a few extras.

Costumes are now visible and equipped from the main menu, enabling you to adjust and preview your character customization and costume settings in-game, side by side. 

We have also added more craftable recipes, including new snow block processor shapes and a totally new block-imprinted bedrock wall! As the Battle of the Blocks winner, lumite wall also gets additions in the form of dark, light, and plain slabs, slopes, stairs, corners, ROUNDED SLOPES, and columns!

notes.title: The Big Update is here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6567866/e99bbbd013288c2db8d849b9453f3e2ca01645e5.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Creators!

The day has finally arrived — the Big Update is here! We know you’ve been waiting a while, but these new features and improvements are sizzling! [I] Drum roll, please. [/I]

We are excited for you to meet our new, improved, and super customizable character models. We hope these new avatars will match the distinct character of the worlds you’ve worked so hard to create.

And let’s talk about [b]combat[/b]. With the new 3rd person combat mode, you’ll have a front row seat to a variety of expanded and polished fighting abilities. Whether you are gauntlet-smashing a swarm of night pigsies to smithereens or dodging Miru’s flash attack with a well-timed roll, you’ll be ready for action. 

[b]THANK YOU[/b] for your continued support while we got this major update ready for you to enjoy. Your continuous creativity, enthusiasm, and feedback is what makes our community so great.

Play on!
-The Creativerse Team


[h1]New Features and Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New & improved player character models!
[list]
[*]Overhaul and improvements for all character models
[*]Extensive animation polish, including facial movement
[/list]
[*]More customization options
[list]
[*]The appearance of your in-game character is no longer tied to equipped armor. This means you have freedom to wear whatever you want without having to look like every other player because you want the gear with the best stats. Visuals and item stats are independent so there is no constraint. 
[*]Five new costume sets inspired by the classic armor are now available — these five costumes are being given away free in the store for current players!
[list]
[*]Check in anytime in the next two weeks and you can get them immediately.
[*]You can mix and max pieces from different sets or use other costume pieces in the game.
[*]Future players will be able to purchase these costumes in the store with coins, including the free coins that we provide at the start of the game.
[/list]
[list]
[*]The five new costumes are:
[list]
[*]Fury Warrior Costume
[*]Electro Cycle Costume
[*]Metal Mk I Costume
[*]First Fantasy Costume
[*]Master Creator Costume
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Improved combat!
[list]
[*]New 3rd-person combat camera!
[list]
[*]Equip your weapon to switch to a third-person perspective.
[list]
[*]3rd-person combat is enabled by default but can be toggled on the Settings menu.
[/list]
[*]You can see everything around you and land your swords with impressive accuracy!
[/list]
[*]New roll move
[list]
[*]Roll by pressing the left-side alt or ctrl button and any directional key. Usable in 3rd-person combat mode.
[list]
[*]Note: The "mouse unbind" hotkey is moved to right-side alt button
[*]There’s an optional advanced setting for double-tapping any direction to roll
[*]You have two roll charges that replenish over time.
[list]
[*]The roll icons to the right of your quickbar on the HUD reflect how many rolls you currently have available
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[*]New AOE Gauntlet Smash attack
[list]
[*]Use your gauntlet smash attack by pressing the middle mouse button (default). Usable in 3rd-person combat mode.
[*]Deal incredible damage to creatures and players around you! BAM!
[list]
[*]Gauntlet smash damage scales with your weapon’s power
[/list]
[*]Use Gauntlet Smash any time you have 75% or more stamina. 
All your remaining stamina will be consumed for this impressive attack.[/list]
[/list]
[*]Improved Stamina Regeneration
[list]
[*]Stamina regeneration now percentage-based, based on your maximum stamina, so players with tons of stamina will recover it just as fast as players without stamina bonuses.
[/list]
[*]Improved combat targeting
[list]
[*]Combat targeting is much more accurate and intuitive
[list]
[*]Using a cone-based targeting system, with an optional aim-assist feature. 
[/list]
[*]Creatures glow red when targeted in melee range.
[/list]
[*]Improved player and creature animations
[list]
[*]A wide range of player animation improvements and polish
[*]New player and creature death, bomb throwing, swimming, and sprint attack animations
[/list]
[*]New intro cinematic when creating a world!
[*]New Help feature
[list]
[*]Visit the Help tab in the codex for descriptions of game items and systems.
[/list]
[*]More QB! QB now welcomes you back to the game and generally shows love for you.
[*]Goo blocks can now be processed into globs of goo (try processing orange or purple goo blocks…
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[*]Major storage boosts!
[list]
[*]Maximum item stack size increased from 300 to 999
[*]Wood Bookshelf (formerly 3 slots) and Wood Chest (formerly 24 slots) are both increased to 25 slots!
[*]Stone Chest (formerly 28 slots) increased to 35 slots!
[*]Blue Gift Box, Green Gift Box, Red Gift Box, Heart Shaped Box, Industrial Locker, Medieval Chest, and Hidden Temple Chest (formerly 32 slots), Pumpkin Chest, Royal Pumpkin Chest, and Arctek Chest (formerly 36 slots) increased to 45 slots!
[*]Grand Arctek Chest and Pumpkiru's King Chest (formerly 40 slots) increased to 60 slots!
[*]Minor consistency changes and small improvements to the crafting recipes for some storage containers
[list]
[*]Any existing chests will not be updated unless re-placed
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Gauntlet pull speed improvements
[list]
[*]Most surface-level blocks pull faster regardless of equipped mining cell
[*]Lower-tier mining cells (base, stone, obsidian) pull a little faster overall
[list]
[*]This change is for newer players to make pulling speed feel crisper and more responsive. Higher-tier mining cells are unchanged.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Crouch more aptly renamed to “Safe Walk”
[*]Added Codex keybinding option
[*]Claim pricing rebalanced
[list]
[*]Individual claim prices reduced by up to 50%.
[*]Players can acquire four additional claims per world with in-game resources.
[*]Max claims per player in a world increased from 24 to 40.
[/list]
[*]Crafting station animations are a bit more responsive
[*]Most items can now be placed underwater without a visible “air box” around them
[list]
[*]We are looking into some weird visuals when placing on top-level water, but this change allows for a much better underwater building experience
[/list]
[*]Audio improvements for weapon swings and improved positional sound effects for other players
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Performance fixes to reduce frame hitching and stuttering
[*]Fire spread performance optimizations
[list]
[*]Burns out twice as fast now and only shows a glow from farther away
[/list]
[*]Networking fix to improve connections, particularly for players on EU and Asia servers
[*]Fixed some bad default configuration values for new users to fix reported issues
[*]Fixed cases where items end up in incorrect quickbar slots
[*]Quest rewards can now be fully claimed even with full inventory
[*]Fixed only being able to take one photo ever for adventure checkpoints
[*]Newly-placed adventure checkpoints should no longer show debug text
[*]Fixed sign text not displaying properly (z-fighting) on signs in some cases
[*]Unlearned seasonal crafting recipes now properly removed from the crafting menu outside of seasonal events
[*]Minor quest text and objective fixes
[*]Minor block description text and categorization fixes
[/list]
[i]Creativerse R55 - The Big Update[/i]

notes.title: Questing with QB
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/z2k0RAQ.png]

Greetings Creators,

The patch notes for the new “Questing with QB” update are below, but we wanted to take this chance to say hello and let you know that the team is hard at work on features and fun for Creativerse.

We have content and improvements planned out that we will deliver over the next few months and even years. We are planning ahead for features and upgrades, both small and large.

We’ll be talking more about our plans later in May, but I will say that our long-term plans are robust, and that we are very excited to keep working on Creativerse serving you as players.

To be fair to new players, we’re going to start calling Creativerse a “live open beta” until we’re finished adding all the new stuff we have planned. This label won’t change anything about your play experience or how we add content the game; it’s simply a way to convey to our newest players how much new stuff is still coming along the pipeline and that the game is far from finished.

We hope you enjoy the new Codex feature, including our first batch of quests for Creativerse and first set of badges. And we hope you enjoy meeting QB. It’s the start of a long and beautiful friendship and you should expect to see more of QB in the future.

We also hope you enjoy the new Finite Gauntlet costume from the store. We appreciate everyone who picks up this item, as it helps us pay our hard-working developers so they can afford more keyboards, rainbow sherbet, and movie tickets.

And finally, we want to thank our “MVP” sneak preview players and anyone who sends us feedback on the game. We track all your feedback and constantly reference it to help us make the best possible decisions for Creativerse.

We think you’re going to love the big and small updates we have planned for Creativerse over the next few months and years, and we’re so excited to bring them to you.

With much love,

The Creativerse Team

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Introducing QB!
[list]
[*]QB is so excited to be your new mentor, advisor, and very best Creati-friend.
[*]There’s more QB fun to come, but for now QB will be your guide to the...
[/list]
[*]New questing and badges system!
[list]
[*]Complete quests in the new Codex to earn loot and unlock badges.
[list]
[*]Quest progress is tracked across worlds; complete your quests in any world you like!
[*]Quests do not progress on adventures.
[/list]
[*]Badges grant permanent upgrades to your character, like critical melee hits and auto-healing.
[list]
[*]You can select one of your unlocked badges on the inventory screen to proudly display it in the world.
[/list]
[*]New players will now earn their free coins by completing quests. The number has been raised from 300 to 350 total.
[list]
[*]As a little bonus, current players can also earn those 350 coins by questing, too. Thanks, QB!
[/list]
[/list]
[*]You voted. We added eight new variants for the “Block Madness” tournament champion: Asphalt!
[list]
[*]Slab, Slope, Slope Corners (Outer and Inner), Stairs, Stair Corners (Outer and Inner), Column
[*]We loved this community event so much that we’re planning to run it again later this year.
[/list]
[*]New free recipe: Stone Lattice Window
[*]New login reward: Quick™ Potion!
[*]New Playful Blueprint: Cozy Cottage
[*]Marvelous new costume: The Finite Gauntlet
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the busted “no gliders” setting for adventures
[*]Added some missing characters to the Creativerse font used on signs and loading screens, and made the '<' and '>' characters face the correct way.
[*]Fix for the weapon tutorial firing at inappropriate times
[*]Fixed cornerstones not being granted with blueprint kit purchases
[*]Minor fix to make Tab key more responsive and consistent in menus
[*]Fix for arc signs using icons or non-default fonts always appearing “on” when first loaded
[*]“Slanted Straw Roof” corners now properly named “Thatched Roof” corners
[/list]
[i]Creativerse R54 - Questing with QB[/i]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Several nonfunctional badge perks should now work beautifully
[*]Fix for adventures not properly completing
[*]Fix for the first "touchstone" quest not auto-accepting & tracking for new players
[*]Replaced stub codex tab icons with stunningly beautiful real ones
[*]Added a keybinding option for the codex
[*]Fix for excavators sometimes creating visual “holes” in the world

This morning’s update features another small batch of incremental changes as we ramp up to some heavy-duty updates ahead. Happy Valentine's, Creators!

Whether you celebrate today with candy, cards, or vehement denunciations of rampant commercialism, you'll find something to love in the Forbidden City Update! It's Valentine's Day and we're seizing the opportunity to [b]show you the love[/b] with a bunch of free stuff!

The stunning new Forbidden City Bundle adds seven new themed recipes (plus a bunch of processed variants) that are bound to end up in some impressive builds and blueprints. And we're making it totally FREE!

Also enjoy a special (free) Valentine's recipe, plus a unique seasonal login reward - the Love Potion!

And if you're looking to buff up your costume collection, swing by the store for a couple killer options. Caution: the legendary Dragon's Breath axe breathes fire...

notes.notes:

Whether you celebrate today with candy, cards, or vehement denunciations of rampant commercialism, you'll find something to love in the Forbidden City Update! It's Valentine's Day and we're seizing the opportunity to [b]show you the love[/b] with a bunch of free stuff!

The stunning new Forbidden City Bundle adds seven new themed recipes (plus a bunch of processed variants) that are bound to end up in some impressive builds and blueprints. And we're making it totally FREE!

notes.title: Official Contest: Take Your Best Shot!
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/ZApkUBO.png]

Greetings, Creators!

Over the last few years, we’ve seen our community share some truly impressive screenshots. Now it’s time to raise the bar and celebrate screenshots that go beyond ”impressive” all the way to “basically melts Steam’s servers to sludge with pure Creativerse awesomeness.”

Your challenge: capture a Creativerse moment that’s so breathtaking, thrilling, hilarious, frightful, or just plain amazing that it should be part of the game forever. That’s right - ten winning screenshots will be added to Creativerse as loading screens!

[h1]Prizes[/h1]

[b]GRAND PRIZE (10)[/b] - Ten grand prize winners will each receive:
[list]
[*]Ultra-Rare Trophy Gauntlet Skin;
[list]
[*]YOUR CHOICE: Gold, Silver, Bronze
[/list]
[*]a Steam key for Creativerse Pro;
[*]2500 coins;
[*]and your screenshot will be added to the game as a new loading screen!
[/list]
[h1]How to Enter[/h1]
[list]
[*]Take a screenshot in Creativerse, upload it, and post the link to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/discussions/0/1699415798764558303/]this forum thread[/url];
[*]Or tweet your screenshot using the hashtag #CreativerseContest.
[list]
[*]Make sure you’re following us ([url=http://www.twitter.com/creativersegame]@creativersegame[/url]) so we can DM the winner.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]How to Win![/h1]

Make us laugh. Make us cry. Blow our minds with an epic build, or soothe our souls with a serene landscape. Selfies, group portraits, Pigsy glamour shots… anything goes! Surprise us with a screenshot that you would love to see as a Creativerse loading screen!

[h1]Rules & Restrictions[/h1]
[list]
[*]The deadline for entries is 11:59 AM CST on Monday, February 19, 2018
[*][b]Important[/b]: screenshots must be exactly 1920x1080 resolution.
[list]
[*]This is so the screenshot will work as a loading screen
[/list]
[*]Screenshots must be in the PNG or JPG format.
[list]
[*]The Steam screenshot tool uses JPG and the Creativerse camera tool uses PNG, so if you use either of those, you’re probably good.
[/list]
[*]No UI; use the /hud command to hide the interface and and get a clear shot.
[*]No Photoshop; we want 100% all-natural unedited screenshots.
[*]No copyrighted stuff; this is not the time to share a screenshot from your [i]Deadpool and Elsa go to Hogwarts[/i] adventure (although you should totally show that to us some other time).
[*][b]Limit one screenshot entered per person[/b]. Take your best shot and make it count!
[*]Make sure you’ve registered your email address in Creativerse so we can contact you if you win.
[*]No purchase necessary; purchase does not enhance chance of winning.
[*]Void where prohibited.
[/list]
[h1]Q&A[/h1]

[b]Q[/b]: Do I have to build everything in my screenshot myself?
[b]A[/b]: Nope! This is a screenshot contest, not a building contest. But it is considered good manners to ask permission before snapping a shot of someone else’s build.

[b]Q[/b]: Do I need to add the Creativerse logo to my screenshot?
[b]A[/b]: Nope, we’ll take care of that for the winning shots.

[b]Q[/b]: How do I upload a screenshot to Steam?
[b]A[/b]: Follow this guide: [url=https://spryfox.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/218503698-How-do-I-share-a-Steam-screenshot-]How to upload a screenshot to Steam[/url].

[b]Q[/b]: Can I use something other than Steam (like imgur) to upload my screenshot?
[b]A[/b]: Sure, as long as we don’t need a special account or anything to access it.

[b]Q[/b]: Got any tips?
[b]A[/b]: If possible, crank your draw distance and other visual options all the way up -- even if it’s just for the one second you need to snap a screenshot.

[b]Q[/b]: Cool! Any more tips?
[b]A[/b]: Did you know Creativerse has a built-in camera tool? It drops PNG format screenshots straight into a folder on your desktop. The default camera key is ‘p’ -- just be sure your game’s resolution is set to 1920x1080 so your shots are loading screen-ready.

[b]Q[/b]: DELICIOUS! FEED TO ME EVEN MORE OF THESE HELPFUL TIPS!
[b]A[/b]: Uh… good luck!

notes.title: A Pebble-Sized Update!
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/Dr8b82K.png]
Greetings, Creators!

Creativerse R51 is a Pebble-sized batch of all the bugfixes and improvements that have piled up as we've been working on some bigger features & fixes for the future. We're gonna let those Rockster-sized improvements continue to simmer for a while longer, but in the meantime there's still plenty to enjoy in this modest Pebble of a patch.

Blocky the Snowman, a [strike]leftover[/strike] [i]brand new[/i] holiday decoration, has been a little cranky since he missed out on all the holiday festivities. Give him some sharp weapons to hold so he can fully express his surly brand of holiday spirit!

Plus we heard your feedback that it took too dang long to tame, wash, and harvest pets, so we sliced all those times in half with the fabled Lumite Sword of Balancing... or maybe Chase the designer changed three numbers in a data file. There's really no way to be certain.

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]New decorative & weapon display item: Blocky the Snowman!
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Pet taming, washing, and harvesting times cut in half
[*]Added opt-out option for newsletters when validating e-mail
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed recent issues with Creativerse Pro occasionally vanishing for a bit
[*]Costume icons now unified to face the same way. Finally!
[*]End of World blocks can no longer be phased and replaced
[*]Fix for other players with female characters playing male voices
[*]Fix for multiple music box sounds not starting if they started on the same frame (via machine activation for example)
[*]Sent the Holiday Hat costume to the dry cleaners - it came back cleaner and brighter
[*]Fix for blueprints extending higher than world height causing lag
[*]Very large blueprints now show up in-world preview (but may still show as incomplete depending on the size)
[*]Fixed broken email and help buttons on main menu
[*]Fix for that 1-pixel UI gap on Message of the Day panel that was driving everyone crazy
[*]Fix for loot chests in decorative containers causing the container UI to open repeatedly
[*]Fix for certain block types (like holiday lights) to correctly show random variants
[/list]
[i]Creativerse R51 - A Pebble-Sized Update[/i]

notes.title: Elfi's Toy Drive Ends on January 10th!
notes.notes:
The holidays may be over, but there's still time to hop in to Creativerse and help Elfi save the day! 

Elfi's Community Toy Drive will continue going strong until the morning of January 10th, at which time the event will end. Make sure to log in and trade Elfi any toys you've recovered before he retires to the tundra for some well-deserved rest!

In case you haven't heard, there are less than 2 million toys required to unlock the final community reward, which includes the super awesome Snowball Turret! Hop in today and help Elfi overcome Troggington's shenanigans!


[h1]FAQ:[/h1]

[list]
[*][b][u]Will my traps still work on those trifling trogs after the event ends?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Traps will continue to work normally after January 10th, but they will no longer be available in the store or as part of a Daily Login Reward.  
[/list]
[*][b][u]What can I do with the toys I didn't trade in?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Players can trade their toys to Elfi up util his departure on January 10th. After that, you can store them however you like in await of Elfi's return!
[/list]
[*][b][u]What will happen to the new costume options?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Like the Halloween-themed costumes, the Winter holiday costumes will remain in the store as we build up a wider selection of costumes. That said, it is possible they will only be seasonally available in the future!
[/list]
[*][b][u]Will Elfi and Troggington ever return to Creativerse?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Elfi and Troggington will definitely return in time. In the meantime however, they have expended a lot of energy and require plenty of rest to recharge their batteries!
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Combeau's Party Pad Contest!
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/88WIfsL.jpg]

Combeau is planning the ultimate New Year party. Not just any venue will do though, so he is enlisting help via [b]Combeau’s Party Pad Contest[/b]!

Descended from a very long line of distinguished party animals, Combeau has won numerous awards for his event planning skills! Here’s your challenge to help him maintain his streak of epic festivities: create a blueprint for the most amazing party pad the Creativerse has ever seen!

[h1]How to Party Down the House & Win Big[/h1]
Build, capture, and publish a celebration destination in the form of a Creativerse blueprint. Take some great screenshots of your build, then follow the steps below to enter.
We’ll pick EIGHT total winners (including three TOP prizewinners) and award those creators with:
[list]
[*][b][u]GRAND PRIZE (1) [/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Glamorous [b]Gold Gauntlet[/b] skin! 
[*]5,000 coins
[/list]
[*][b][u]SECOND PRIZE (1) [/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Sparkling [b]Silver Gauntlet[/b] skin! 
[*]5,000 coins
[/list]
[*][b][u]THIRD PRIZE (1) [/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Bedazzling [b]Bronze Gauntlet[/b] skin! 
[*]5,000 coins
[/list]
[*][b][u]HONORABLE MENTION (a minimum of 5) [/u][/b]
[list]
[*] 5,000 coins
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]How to Enter[/h1]
[list]
[*]Post your entry (include both a link to your blueprint’s Steam Workshop page AND some screenshots to show it off) on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/discussions/0/2549465882933254118/]official contest thread on our Steam forums[/url];
[*]Or Tweet your entry (both the link and the pics) using the hashtag #CreativerseContest (make sure you’re following us so we can DM the winner).
[/list]
[h1]Official Rules[/h1]
[list]
[*]The deadline for entries is Monday, January 15th, 2018 at noon CST.
[*]Limit one entry per person.
[*]You're free to work together with others, but the prize will go to the person that submits the winning entry.
[*]Whether it’s a small yard party or a giant disco you’re making, your creativity should shine through your blueprint. Make us want to drop everything and dance!
[list]
[*]Entries should be a single blueprint of any size (small, medium, or large).
[*]Players of all skill levels are welcome and encouraged to participate. All entries will be considered regardless of skill level involved.
[/list]
[*]Use screenshots to show us details the blueprint thumbnail can’t capture!
[*]Playful and Combeau will judge blueprints and select winners via either or all of the following criteria:
[list]
[*][u]Creativity[/u] - The amount of thought and imagination that went into the blueprint, regardless of size, scope, or complexity.
[*][u]Innovation[/u] - The way blocks and items are uniquely utilized within a build.
[/list]
[*]Players of all skill levels are welcome and encouraged to participate
[*]Make sure you’ve registered your e-mail in Creativerse so we can contact you if you win.
[*]Playful employees, their families, rambeaus, and other creati-creatures are ineligible to participate or win.
[*]Combeau required that we duly note he was most displeased with being overlooked for the recent blueprint contest. He uttered a muffled snort that roughly translates to “Cosmo-Chizzard can choke on a mushroom sandwich”.
[*]No purchase necessary; purchase does not enhance chance of winning.
[*]Void where prohibited.
[/list]

notes.title: Elfi's Toy Drive Comes to Creativerse!
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/LTrqmih.png]
Happy Holidays, Creators!

Tis the season to spread cheer, and that’s exactly what the celebrated toymaker Elfi had planned to do -- before Troggington the Abominable Snow Trog made off with all of his toys, that is. Now, he’s depending on you to get back those presents and save the holidays for the whole Creativerse!
  
Elfi’s Toy Drive expands upon the dynamic event system introduced in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/discussions/0/1483233503862338943/]Halloween update[/url] with exciting new challenges and frosty cool rewards spanning classic holiday recipes and festive new goodies. New premium items round out the update with a flurry of new costume pieces and the supernaturally beautiful Frost Block Set!

Utilize Elfi’s Trog Traps to capture Troggington and his minions, take back those presents, and then return them to Elfi in exchange for a reward of your choice. That’s right -- this time you can pick and choose which rewards you want to aim for!

Work together with the community and surpass milestones to unlock a range of increasingly epic rewards. Speaking of range, did we mention we’re introducing a turret? Because we’re introducing a turret.

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]

notes.title: Experience the Column Craze!
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/lu0JXoo.png]
Greetings, Creators!

This update is all about three things: Greater stability. Improved performance. Column blocks shaped from the finest, pointiest, shredded leaves.

[h1]Stability & Performance[/h1]

We heard your feedback that game performance is due for a tune-up, and we've dived deep under the hood to make impactful improvements with the goal of getting Creativerse to run as smooth as a Miru's central eyeball (which we assume is pretty smooth, although we're not gonna get close enough to a Miru to find out).

Importantly, with this update [b]Creativerse is now a 64-bit game[/b] - an upgrade we expect will significantly improve stability and reduce crashing.

[h1]A Cornucopia of Columns[/h1]

[i]"I don't care about all that technical mumbo jumbo; give me round things!"[/i] - someone, probably

We've got you, fam. Get thee to a processor to start churning out gloriously round column versions of eighteen of your favorite blocks (all free in the core game, btw).

So fire up a more stable, more performant Creativerse today and experience... the Column Craze!

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]18 new column blocks - free for everyone!
[list]
[*]Lumite Column (process Lumite Wall)
[*]Corrupted Stone Column (process Corrupted Stone Wall)
[*]Diamond Column (process Diamond Glass)
[*]Hardened Lava Column (process Hardened Lava Wall)
[*]Igneous Column (process Igneous Wall)
[*]Iron Column (process Iron Wall)
[*]Spiral Limestone Column (process Spiral Limestone Column block)
[*]Straight Limestone Column (process Straight Limestone Column block)
[*]Bedrock Column (process Bedrock Wall)
[*]Limestone Column (process Limestone Wall)
[*]Obsidian Column (process Obsidian Brick Wall)
[*]Stacked Stone Column (process Stacked Stone Wall)
[*]Yellow Wood Column (process Yellow Wood Wall)
[*]Blue Wood Column (process Blue Wood Wall)
[*]Red Wood Column (process Red Wood Wall)
[*]Wood Column (process Wood Wall)
[*]Thatched Column (process Thatched Wall)
[*]Shredded Leaves Column (process Shredded Leaves)
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Creativerse is now built using the 64-bit Unity platform [b]*[/b]
[list]
[*]This will improve stability and reduce crashing.
[/list]
[*]Various performance improvements
[list]
[*]Improved occlusion culling
[*]Improved sound loading
[*]Reduced entity unloading cost
[*]Other minor improvements
[/list]
[*]Elevation indicator added to death statue compass UI element
[*]Creativerse sprites added to the arc sign! Use this new tag
[list]
[*]Format: <sprite="icons_00" index=0>
[*]Try different index values and sprite=”icons_01”, too!
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Refitted Pumpkiru’s Top Hat so it fits better on the Calavera Cabeza costume
[*]Fixed issue where multiple flashlight sources could be allocated (degrading performance and requiring multiple toggles to switch them off)
[*]Adjusted creature positions so they aren’t floating above the terrain, which was weird
[*]“Server draining” messages now appear properly
[*]Fixed incorrect “stick” weapon sometimes appearing on the character equipment screen
[*]Fix for invisible textures on slabs and slopes in certain placement configurations
[*]Fix for some discontinued item bundles not being properly claimable
[*]Fix for sign text sometimes not rendering correctly
[*]Fix for some machine hotspot text not showing
[/list]
* An overwhelming majority of our players are running 64-bit operating systems and won't have to do anything but enjoy a more stable gameplay experience. However, a very small subset of players are still running 32-bit versions of Windows, which are no longer supported. If you're one of those players, we've put together this FAQ to help.

[i]Creativerse R49 - The Column Craze![/i]

notes.title: Creativerse Goes 64-bit on November 15th!
notes.notes:
Hello Creators,

Over the past few months, we have investigated reports of reduced performance and worked hard on changes that will reduce crashes and improve overall game performance. Our update tentatively scheduled for November 15th will contain a number of performance optimizations, and will upgrade Creativerse to a 64-bit client.

Upgrading to a 64-bit client will address a majority of memory-related crashes players report and set Creativerse on a path for more ambitious content. A vast majority of our players are already utilizing 64-bit operating systems, and are all set to enjoy the improved gameplay. A small number of players however, are still running 32-bit versions of Windows which will no longer be supported with the update release

In preparation for the release, we have put together an FAQ to help you make sure your system is prepared:

[h1]MAC USERS:[/h1]
[*][b]I use Mac OS X, will I be able to play after the update?[/b]
[list]
[*]Mac OS X is a 64-bit operating system, so you are all set!
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]WINDOWS USERS:[/h1]
[*][b]How can I tell if I am using a 32-bit or 64-bit version of Windows?[/b]
[list]
[*]Use [url=https://www.computerhope.com/issues/ch001121.htm]this guide.[/url] Follow the instructions for your version of Windows under "Determine if Windows Vista, 7, 8 and 10 is 32-bit or 64-bit"
[/list]
[*] [b]How can I tell if my computer can run a 64-bit version of Windows?[/b]
[list]
[*] Use [url=https://www.computerhope.com/issues/ch001121.htm]this guide.[/url] Follow the instructions under "Windows CPU type"
[/list]
[*][b]Okay, I'm running a 32-bit version of Windows and my and my CPU [i]does not[/i] support 64-bit. Can I still play?[/b]
[list]
[*]Unfortunately this means you won't be able to play since you cannot install the 64-bit version of Windows on your system without an upgrade.
[/list]
[*][b]Alright, I'm running a 32-bit version of Windows and my CPU [b]does[/b] support 64-bit[/b]
[list]
[*]You're in luck! This means you're using a 32-bit version of Windows but your CPU can run a 64-bit version, so you may be able to upgrade.
[/list]
[/list]
Edit: Updated the projected date of the release to Wednesday, November 15

notes.title: Pumpkiru's Candy Campaign Ends Soon!
notes.notes:
The Great Pumpkiru's sweet tooth has nearly been laid to rest and is almost ready for its yearly slumber! Pumpkiru's Candy Campaign will officially end on November 14th, so make sure to log in and trade him for those pumpkin treasures before he leaves! 

You guys did an amazing job and we couldn't be prouder. Can you believe that over 1,500,000 idols were destroyed!? That's a lot of zeroes! 


[h1]FAQ:[/h1]

[list]
[*][b][u]What about the idols? Will they still work?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Idols will continue to work normally after November 14th, but they will no longer be available in the store or as a Daily Login Reward.  
[/list]
[*][b][u]What can I do with all this leftover candy?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Candy can be traded to Pumpkiru up until the time of his departure on November 14th. After that time, it's your choice: will you save the candy for next year, or enjoy the sweets yourself?
[/list]
[*][b][u]What will happen to the new costumes?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We’re planning to leave the Halloween-themed costumes in the store for a while as we build up a wider selection of costumes, but it’s possible in the future they would start to be available only seasonally.
[/list]
[*][b][u]Will the Great Pumpkiru return?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! And if Pumpkiru Jr does well enough in school, he may even get to participate a bit more next time!
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Costumes are here!
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/47neilS.png]
Surprise, Creators!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V7i30B494xw]Pumpkiru’s Candy Campaign[/url] is still in full swing, so there’s plenty of time yet to banish thieving ghosts back to the spirit realm and return mounds of succulent candy to a monstrous yet admirably well-dressed Miru NPC in exchange for horrifying seasonal recipes and something called... “bat juice.” But would Halloween even be Halloween without costumes? Thankfully we’ll never have to find out, because costumes have come to Creativerse!

This small but sugary-sweet second Halloween update establishes the foundation for a new premium costume system. We’ve added a Hauntster’s claw-ful of (cosmetic, totally optional) costume pieces - like the Great Pumpkiru’s iconic top hat! - to the store, and are planning to add many more in the future.

We’re also continuing our focus on improvements and bugfixes, and we expect a fix for collisions and the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/discussions/1/1483233503862142931/]upcoming upgrade to a 64-bit client[/url] to help make your play experience a bit smoother.

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Costumes - just in time for Halloween!
[list]
[*]Costumes are premium, account-bound cosmetic swaps that can be worn in any world.
[*]Heads, hats, gauntlets, weapons, and the flashlight are currently supported.
[*]We’ll unlock more costume slots and add many more costumes in the future!
[/list]
[*]New premium costumes available!
[list]
[*]Calavera Cabeza (Head)
[*]Pumpkiru’s Top Hat (Hat)
[*]The Hulking Hand (Gauntlet Skin)
[*]Grim Reaper (Weapon Skin)
[*]Crypt Cutter (Weapon Skin)
[*]Ghostly Flashlight (Flashlight)
[list]
[*]Requires Creativerse Pro
[*]We’re giving this away for free for a limited time! Use the code [b]GHOSTLYGHIFT[/b] in the store to permanently unlock the Ghostly Flashlight costume for your account.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added visual indicator icons for claim settings when passing a claim boundary
[*]Chat icon indicators for world owners and admins
[*]Your weapon now gets put away during glider flight. So much safer!
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for collision bug introduced in previous hotfix that caused more frequent launches into the air for players and creatures
[*]Claim admins can now adjust advanced options properly
[*]Taming bell and washer no longer show up incorrectly in third-person
[*]Beacons are now visible on shelves and in other containers
[/list]
[i]Creativerse R48 - Pumpkiru's Candy Campaign Continues[/i]

notes.title: Cosmo-Chizzard's Blueprint Contest!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bIzkQCx.png[/img]

The Galactic Chizzard Coop is all fired up, and Cosmo-Chizzard is ready to break the laws of space and time to bring you [b]Cosmo-Chizzard’s Blueprint Contest[/b]!

It’s no secret that Cosmo-Chizzard knows a thing or two about being a space cadet, and now’s time to show him...and the universe...what you’ve got! Here’s your challenge: create the most incredible [b]sci-fi themed blueprint[/b] in the entire Creativerse!

[h1]How to Blow Cosmo’s Mind & Win Big[/h1]

Build, capture, and publish an amazing sci-fi themed blueprint in Creativerse. Take some great screenshots of your build, then follow the steps below to enter.

We’ll pick EIGHT total winners (including three TOP prizewinners) and award those creators with:
[list]
[*][b][u]GRAND PRIZE (1) [/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Brand new, never-before-seen [b]Gold Gauntlet[/b] skin! 
[*]5,000 coins
[/list]
[*][b][u]SECOND PRIZE (1) [/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Stunning [b]Silver Gauntlet[/b] skin! 
[*]5,000 coins
[/list]
[*][b][u]THIRD PRIZE (1) [/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Impressive [b]Bronze Gauntlet[/b] skin! 
[*]5,000 coins
[/list]
[*][b][u]HONORABLE MENTION (5) [/u][/b]
[list]
[*] 5,000 coins
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]How to Enter[/h1]
[list]
[*]Post your entry (include both a link to your blueprint’s Steam Workshop page AND some screenshots to show it off) on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/discussions/0/1519260397775505383/]the official contest thread[/url] on our Steam forums;
[*]Or Tweet your entry (both the link and the pics) using the hashtag #CreativerseContest (make sure you’re following us so we can DM the winner).
[/list]
[h1]Official Rules[/h1]
[list]
[*]The UPDATED deadline for entries is Wednesday, October 18, 2017 at 12:01 AM CST.
[*]Limit one entry per person.
[*]You're free to work together with others, but the prize will go to the person that submits the winning entry.
[*]Your blueprint’s creativity and design should blow our minds straight into the future!
[*]Use screenshots to show us details the blueprint thumbnail can’t capture!
[*]Blueprints will be judged and winners selected by Playful and Cosmo-Chizzard himself. (He was the chief decision maker of his home world before he accidentally destroyed it, after all!)
[*]Make sure you’ve registered your e-mail in Creativerse so we can contact you if you win.
[*]Playful employees, their families, and survivors from Cosmo-Chizzard’s home world are ineligible to participate or win.
[*]Cosmo-Chizzard has a bet with fellow contest host Combeau that his entries will be ten times as stunning as the ones for Combeau’s Adventure [*]Contest – don’t let him down!
[*]Gauntlet skin prizes may require some additional in-game hookup, and will be issued as soon as possible.
[*]No purchase necessary; purchase does not enhance chance of winning.
[*]Void where prohibited.
[/list]

notes.title: The Galactic Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/m6TLLk7.png[/img]
Greetings, Creators!

The Galactic Update really feels like two updates in one.

First, we're over the moon to present the new [b]Galactic Super Bundle[/b]! Our most stellar premium recipe pack yet features fantastic futuristic designs that'll be perfect for sci-fi-inspired creations -- and you'll definitely want the beautiful and deadly-sharp Flux Incapacitator on hand for any Galactic "Treks" or "Wars" you have coming up.

You can pick up the super bundle from the store today, and while you’re there claim a [b]complimentary blueprint kit[/b] for the out-of-this-world Galactic Chizzard Coop to try out all the new blocks for free!

And second, [b]the Blueprint Revolution is back[/b]! We’ve unlocked several powerful features that make creating and building blueprints easier and more fun than ever. Now you can capture complex machines and decorations in your blueprints, start building faster using block kits for player-created blueprints, and wield an explosive new blueprint building ability -- Burst Fill!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1126272380
[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Galactic Super Bundle now available for purchase! 🚀
[list]
[*]Can I interest you in a free sample? Visit the store to pick up a kit for the out-of-this-world Galactic Chizzard Coop blueprint for zero coins!
[/list]
[*]Core blocks added:
[list]
[*]Reinforced Glass Slope
[*]Reinforced Glass Slope Inner & Outer Corners
[/list]
[*]Blueprint kits for player-created blueprints now available!
[list]
[*]Get the blocks instantly for any blueprint in the workshop, plus they come in a really sturdy crate.
[*]Custom block-swapped blueprints? No problem, we’ve got custom kits now.
[*]Kits are dynamically priced based on block type and count.
[/list]
[*]New Blueprint Ability: Burst Fill
[list]
[*]Right-click to place multiple similar blueprint blocks at once!
[*]Hold SHIFT and right-click to place just one block.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Item stack size increased to 300!
[*]Advanced Blueprint Capture
[list]
[*]Capture blocks now save machine connections and object settings (like sign text or that lamp you left ON even though you were the last one to leave the room)
[*]Teleporters, shelves, and other decorative containers are captured with the items they contain
[list]
[*]Note: these special captured items can’t be removed by the blueprint builder, but they can be overwritten with real items
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Creatures got smarter: improved combat pathing and more accurate creature targeting
[*]Fences got smarter: they now only link to flat sides of slopes, stairs, corners, and slabs
[*]Added copy/paste buttons for LED block settings
[*]Holiday event recipes can no longer be learned on adventures. But is that a spooky sensation we detect in the air...?
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for messed-up medieval stairs texture
[*]Teleporters and placemats properly render in blueprint previews
[*]Pressure plate now can be properly targeted by wiring tool
[*]Fix for missing message when dragging ore onto quickbar
[*]Minor localization fixes
[*]Fix for swords & crowbars appearing giant in decorative containers
[*]Fix for some block phaser exploits
[*]Memory management improvements (which may help prevent some crashes)
[/list]

[i]Creativerse R46 - The Galactic Update[/i]

notes.title: The Blueprint Revolution Update!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/80jSabH.jpg]
Greetings, Creators!

In the two years since we introduced the very first blueprints (Pigsy Statue 4 LIFE~!), we've carefully kept our blueprint creation tools under lock and key here at Playful HQ. Today, for the first time, we're unleashing those tools and putting the power of blueprint creation in your hands.

The Blueprint Revolution Update adds Steam Workshop support to Creativerse to give players access to unlimited blueprint content published by our brilliant community. You’ll be able to browse through an always-expanding library of community blueprints to spark your creativity and revolutionize your world.

Think you’ve got a build that’s blueprint-worthy? Craft up a Capture Block (they come in a few sizes) and use it to generate your own blueprint to publish directly to the Workshop!

And the Blueprint Revolution wouldn't be complete without a fully streamlined and polished blueprint experience. Upgraded visuals, better menus and interfaces, and full 3D blueprint previews (including custom swapped blocks) round out this revolutionary set of changes.

The wait is over -- launch Creativerse NOW to join the Blueprint Revolution!

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]New! Steam workshop support for player blueprints
[list]
[*]Craft capture stones (consumable) to capture small, medium, and large blueprints
[*]Publish blueprints directly to the Steam workshop from within the game
[/list]
[*]Blueprint system overhaul
[list]
[*]New blueprint placement visualizations
[*]New simplified flow for blueprint activation and kit purchase
[*]New advanced options for blueprints (under Settings / Controls)
[list]
[*]Allow blueprint override placement - allow placement of incorrect blocks in blueprints (also works by holding shift on placement)
[*]Show all blueprint previews - shows previews for the unactivated cornerstones of other players
[/list]
[*]All blueprint cornerstones now free to craft
[*]Cornerstones no longer included with blueprint kits
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Minor improvements to inventory scrolling
[*]Camera UI reskinned to match other UI elements
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]“Last Online” time / date for player lists now correct
[*]Fix for broken sound on industrial switch
[*]Red, Blue, and Yellow Pet Bow Ties now correctly have a chance to drop
[*]Several minor fixes for text
[/list]
[i]Creativerse R45 - The Blueprint Revolution Update[/i]

notes.title: Pebble's Super Summer Sandcastle Contest!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/lDjHeyI.png]
Summertime is nearly here, and Pebble’s kicking the season off with a [b]Super Summer Sandcastle Contest[/b]!

As you already know, Pebble is a renowned sandcastle expert and art lover. Your challenge is simple: build the ultimate sandcastle (in Creativerse!), or create some Creativerse fan art that’ll fill Pebble’s thorax with summer spirit!

[h1]Challenge & Prizes[/h1]

Build a sandcastle in Creativerse and submit your best screenshots, or create and submit some summer-inspired Creativerse fan art.

We’ll pick our favorite [b]TEN[/b] submissions and award the creators with:
[list]
[*]A Creativerse Pro Steam DLC key;
[*]a Welcome Bundle Steam DLC key;
[*]and a Bucket of Coins!
[/list]
[h1]How to Enter[/h1]
[list]
[*]Post your entry (a link to your sandcastle screenshots or summer-inspired Creativerse fan art) on the official contest thread on our Steam forums (in other words, here!);
[*]or Tweet us your entry [url=https://twitter.com/creativersegame]@creativersegame[/url] including the hashtag #CreativerseContest along with your Steam ID (and make sure you’re following us so we can DM the winner).
[/list]
[h1]Official Rules[/h1]
[list]
[*]Deadline for entries is 6/21/2017 at 12pm CST.
[*]Limit one entry per person.
[*]You’re free to work together with others, but the prize will go to the person that submits the winning entry.
[*]Sandcastles don’t have to be made completely of sand, but they should definitely *look* like a sandcastle.
[*]You don't have to, but you can submit up to five (5) screenshots to show off your sandcastle build.
[*]Your sandcastle builds should make us say "wow!" Creativity, design, and aesthetics matter.
[*]Screenshots and artwork will be judged and winners selected by Playful and a scuttle of discerning Pebbles. (Turns out “scuttle” is the scientific name for a group of Pebbles. Who knew?)
[*]Make sure you’ve registered your e-mail in Creativerse so we can contact you if you win.
[*]Neither employees and family of employees of Playful nor Pebble’s Uncle Rockster are eligible to participate and win.
[*]No purchase necessary; purchase does not enhance chance of winning.
[*]Void where prohibited.
[/list]

notes.title: The Welcome Update!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/K3uyXUE.png]
Greetings, Creators!

We're excited to introduce the Welcome Bundle - a brand new DLC stacked with coins and rare recipes. It's a perfect pick for new players or anyone that appreciates a stellar deal.

And by popular demand, we've added corner versions for all the remaining slab and slope sets (like dirt and grass). Henceforth let no dirt hut be un-cornered!

This is a relatively small update, but it's got some important fixes (we bribed your pets to make sure they don't mysteriously disappear so often), and we've got plenty more exciting stuff on the horizon!

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Additional corner blocks for these blocks:
[list]
[*]Grass Slope and Stairs
[*]Dirt Slope and Stairs
[*]Peakstone Slope and Stairs
[*]Bedrock Slope and Stairs
[*]Blue Adobe Slope and Stairs
[*]Red Adobe Slope and Stairs
[*]Yellow Adobe Slope and Stairs
[*]Adobe Slope and Stairs
[/list]
[*]New “Welcome Bundle” DLC now available for purchase! Includes:
[list]
[*]1500 coins
[*]5 rare crafting recipes
[list]
[*]Gold Sword
[list]
[*]About as sharp and choppy as an iron sword, but gold-plated!
[/list]
[*]Gold Potion
[*]3 Unique Decorative Gold Blocks
[/list]
[*]over 900 bundled blocks and items!
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Warmworm and Hotfoot now sometimes drop iron ore
[*]Added store hotkey to remap list
[*]Pets default to follow when tamed
[*]Basic bed now has unique color
[*]Added basic option to disable corruption (both global for world, and for individual claims, defaults to off in both cases)
[*]Corruption balance adjustments
[list]
[*]Reduced radius of corruption bomb
[*]Corrupted forests of different wood types can now be purified
[*]Increased corruption resistance of all wood types
[/list]
[*]Added break effect / animation when tool breaks
[*]Additional protection against many cheats
[*]“Bundles” header in store now called “Items”
[*]Block kits and bundles now auto-sort to the top of the inventory
[*]Existing lumite-strength Gold Sword renamed Legendary Gold Sword
[*]Tweaks to craft description UI
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixes for pets mysteriously vanishing when wandering
[*]Fixed many cases of visual sparkling, especially in first cave layer
[*]World chats that incorrectly attributed TNT detonations fixed
[*]Fix for machine connection hotspot issues when rotating some machines
[*]Screenshots now work for 4K resolutions
[*]Menu of resolution options now scrolls for monitors that support lots of resolutions
[*]Fixes for some alt-tab issues where Creativerse loses focus
[*]Fixed math errors resulting in errors in some loot tables
[/list]
[i]Creativerse R43: The Welcome Update[/i]

notes.title: The Launch Update!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/tUJ59vV.png]
Welcome, Creators!

Early Access may be over but the ride is just getting started. Grab a friend and join the fun -- Creativerse is officially LAUNCHED!

We're kicking off launch by releasing a top community-requested Creativerse feature: [b]stair and roof corner blocks[/b]! Plus we've leveled up the game with our usual fleet of fixes, optimizations, and balance tweaks. (You spoke. We heard. Super extractors just got super-charged.)

Whether you're a Creati-veteran or discovering the world of Creativerse for the very first time (in which case, try to find some shelter before nightfall - you’ll thank us later), we're thrilled to have you along for the ride!

P.S. For a glimpse at what comes next, don't miss [url=http://playfulcorp.tumblr.com/post/160269493404/our-bold-vision-for-the-future-of-creativerse]this blog post[/url] by our game director.

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]New corner blocks!
[list]
[*]Process crafted stairs and roofs in the processor to make inside and outside corners
[/list]
[*]New placemat item
[list]
[*]Use to place and arrange decorative items on most flat surfaces
[/list]
[*]New block bundles
[list]
[*]Medieval Pack
[*]Hidden Temple Pack
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Memory usage & performance improvements
[*]Added teleporter tutorial screen
[*]Additional protection against some exploits
[*]Balance adjustments
[list]
[*]Super extractor now returns 3.5x base ore value (up from 3)
[*]Forge time for iron ore is 20 seconds (down from 30)
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed most cases of missing visual chunks
[*]Fix for visual “missing block” when half-pulling other blocks
[*]Fix for broken block outlines when building blueprints
[*]Fixed low light level of medieval torches
[*]Purchased bundles now show up properly when inventory page first opened
[*]Fixed bad shader on medieval throne
[*]Medieval door can now be wired
[*]Tweaked loadscreen to fix minor visual issue
[*]Fixed minor issues with missing text strings for some items
[/list]

notes.title: Creativerse is launching on May 8!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6567866/c48f0efd3ff06b745b7d1fe111a09a0c7ee5c20b.jpg[/img]

The day is nearly here.

[b]Creativerse will graduate from Early Access on May 8.[/b]

In 6 days, we will cross a very important milestone in the game’s development. It’s the moment we say to the world, “Ok, everyone into the pool!” We will open the doors to an even bigger audience and invite them into the amazing, delightful world of Creativerse.

For all of you who’ve been on this journey with us and helped us build this game together, this will be just another step. Our shared hopes and dreams for what this game can become have no limits. We still have much more planned for Creativerse. Tomorrow, for the first time ever, we’ll share a glimpse of that roadmap with you—details about what we have planned and where we hope to go from here.

Until then, we wanted to thank all of you for supporting us during Early Access. Your feedback is invaluable to us and influences the game’s destiny every single day. To show our thanks, use the code “[b]THANKYOU[/b]” in the game’s store (click the “redeem” button) from now until May 7 to get the super rare recipe for the Unicorn Sword, aka The Rainbownator 5000, as well as the Ultimate Machines Pack!

notes.title: Colossal Castle!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QUeid6N.png[/img]
Greetings, Creators!

There are big updates, and then there are COLOSSAL updates. R41 tips the scales with our biggest-ever set of new blocks, our most massive blueprint yet, plus a hugely impactful gameplay balance pass. (And that's not all...)

First, swing by the store to check out the new Medieval Super Bundle, which sports TWENTY brand new medieval-themed premium recipes and a moat-load of bundled blocks! And you'll definitely want those blocks if you decide to take on the epic Colossal Castle Blueprint - a towering 20k block construction of turrets, keeps, ramparts, portcullises, and even a cozy stable for Joffrey, your pet Hoglet.

There's also major fine-tuning of gameplay that rebalances combat, crafting, bombs, and more (explosive spoiler: TNT just got a whole lot stronger). AND we've made substantial performance impropvements that'll have the game running more solidly and smoothly than ever.

Grab some popcorn and settle in - colossal fun awaits!

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Major balance pass (details below)!
[*]New Premium Block Set: Medieval Super Bundle!
[list]
[*]Medieval Brick Wall
[*]Medieval Banner Wall
[*]Medieval Crest Wall
[*]Medieval Brick Inset Wall
[*]Medieval Spike Wal
[*]Medieval Torch
[*]Medieval Lamp
[*]Medieval Sword
[*]Medieval Switch
[*]Medieval Chair
[*]Medieval Throne
[*]Medieval Stairs
[*]Medieval Carpeted Stairs
[*]Medieval Roof
[*]Medieval Door
[*]Medieval Fireplace
[*]Medieval Chandelier
[*]Medieval Chain
[*]Medieval Chest
[*]Medieval Table
[/list]
[*]New Colossal Castle blueprint
[*]Several new “bundles” purchase options
[*]Overhauled ingame tutorial
[list]
[*]Type “/tutorial reset” if you’d like to try these from the beginning. Type “/tutorial off” if you’d like to shut them off.
[/list]
[*]Sleeping in beds now restores health to full
[*]New sleeping animations
[*]Hold shift and click to process or forge five things at a time
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Overhauled store UI
[*]Revised and improved ingame HUD
[*]Tweaks to world / adventure browser UI
[*]New Creativerse logo applied ingame
[*]Creature “push” animations and effects improved
[*]Added warning when trying to publish an adventure without a screenshot or description
[*]Sword art overhaul
[*]Gauntlet art overhaul
[*]Keepa ascend / descend animations added
[*]Tweaks to creature and player animations
[*]Taking a picture from an adventure gate or checkpoint UI returns you to that UI after the picture is taken
[*]Exiting to main menu from an adventure or world will take you to the adventure (or world) browser
[*]Improved creature selection for mob spawner
[*]Health and stamina bars now show value
[*]Better default name and description for unassigned adventure gates
[*]Improved store surfacing ingame
[*]Player’s first world now has “Default to Visitor” basic option on by default
[*]Various new sounds and music fixes
[*]Add tabbing through fields in machine UIs
[*]Significant improvements to ‘picking’ detection so it better matches what you are are visually aiming at
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Substantial memory usage and performance fixes
[*]Lighting fixes
[*]Fixed ladder animations
[*]Fixed ladder top dismount
[*]Added feedback for attempting to purchase Pro when the Steam overlay is off
[*]Fix for shadows jittering the further from the center of the map the player goes
[*]Fix for occlusion culling to account for shadow casting direction
[*]Fixed a bug that caused sign text to stop showing up when leaving area and returning
[*]Add missing PVP setting to claim, so PVP can be enabled within a claim. Claim PVP setting overrides world PVP settings, like fire and TNT.
[*]Client can recover from some temporary file write access issues, generally from anti-virus or anti-malware programs scanning files that the game downloads to the user temp directory before moving them to the game directory.  This would cause the changes in a world not to be reflected by that client.
[/list]
[h1]Balance Pass[/h1]
[list]
[*]TNT
[list]
[*]Coal can now be processed into gunpowder (1:1 exchange)
[*]TNT can blow up fossil layer at 4 radius
[*]TNT now unlocks on collecting coal
[*]Large TNT is now Strong TNT
[*]Strong TNT can blow up stalactite layer with 5 radius
[*]Strong TNT unlocks on crafting TNT
[*]Advanced TNT now blows up lava layer at 6 radius
[*]Advanced TNT unlocks on crafting Strong TNT
[*]Super TNT now blows up corruption layer at 7 radius
[*]Super TNT unlocks on crafting advanced TNT
[/list]

notes.title: Colossal Castle!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QUeid6N.png[/img]
Greetings, Creators!

There are big updates, and then there are COLOSSAL updates. R41 tips the scales with our biggest-ever set of new blocks, our most massive blueprint yet, plus a hugely impactful gameplay balance pass. (And that's not all...)

First, swing by the store to check out the new Medieval Super Bundle, which sports TWENTY brand new medieval-themed premium recipes and a moat-load of bundled blocks! And you'll definitely want those blocks if you decide to take on the epic Colossal Castle Blueprint - a towering 20k block construction of turrets, keeps, ramparts, portcullises, and even a cozy stable for Joffrey, your pet Hoglet.

There's also major fine-tuning of gameplay that rebalances combat, crafting, bombs, and more (explosive spoiler: TNT just got a whole lot stronger). AND we've made substantial performance impropvements that'll have the game running more solidly and smoothly than ever.

notes.title: Mob Makeover Mayhem!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/KELxV6g.png[/img]
Greetings, Creators!

For our fortieth release, we loaded the creatures of Creativerse up in a huge van (there were... smells) and treated them to a day at the Mob Groomer for makeovers! Now they're sporting shinier coats (improved lighting and visuals), a few new tricks (additional animations and polish), plus Warmworm convinced us to splurge on an extreme makeover you’ll have to see to believe.

These changes are part of a broader effort to level up the existing game experience with a focus on bugfixes, performance, polish, and quality of life improvements (including a few excellent community requests).

You'll want to experience these changes for yourself - and when you make it down to the lava layer, be sure to tell Warmworm how much you LOVE its "hot" new style!

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adventure picture frames
[list]
[*]Two new craftable picture frames
[*]Display screenshots of completed adventures in your worlds
[/list]
[*]Adventure loadscreens now include adventure picture and description
[*]Significant overhaul of Warmworm art
[*]Improved visuals, lighting, and animations of many other creatures
[*]Plow tool now transforms more blocks
[list]
[*]Ashenwood
[*]Elderwood Leaves
[*]Snow
[*]Cragwood
[*]Autumnwood Leaves
[*]Weepwood
[*]Sand
[*]Tall grass can no longer be plowed
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Engine upgrade - performance improvements, other related bugfixes
[*]Adventures with no screenshot or description will no longer be surfaced on the New and Popular pages
[*]Claim borders for adjacent claims belonging to the same player no longer display
[*]Double-clicking on a player name in touchstone list will teleport to that touchstone
[*]Map no longer available in adventures
[*]Improved TNT and stun bomb art
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for lighting flickering issues on certain video cards
[*]Flashlight can no longer be turned on via the character screen UI element in adventures where the flashlight is disallowed
[*]Fix for block phaser boundaries appearing sometimes when it should not
[*]Resolution dropdown no longer resets when changing other visual options.
[*]Deprecated wood mining cell no longer appears in loot tables
[*]Fixed minor UI visual glitch when shift-click crafting
[*]Arc sign text limit of 10K characters imposed
[*]Store now can be closed with ESC key on main menu
[*]Various stability and crash fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Combeau's Super Adventure Contest!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/RLyRqfx.jpg]

Now that Published Adventures are live in Creativerse, we can't wait to see what you all come up with. And we're willing to sweeten the pot with a totally insane, off the ladder-coaster contest!

This is no ordinary contest. This is...

[h1][b]Combeau's Super Adventure Contest![/b][/h1]

Combeau has decreed the theme for this contest is “[i]I wanna play that again[/i]”. We couldn’t get him to be more specific, so we’re rolling with it. If your adventure is good enough to play twice*, it’s a contender for the win. Speaking of which...

TEN winners will receive a $25 Steam gift card and have their adventure featured on our main menu! They’ll also get a Creativerse Pro key and 2000 coins. 

All the particulars are below. Frankly, the stakes have never been higher. If you call yourself a Creatifriend you owe it to yourself to consider entering.

--The Playful Team


[h1][u]All The Particulars[/u][/h1]

[b]Rules & Guidelines[/b]
[list]
[*]Publish an adventure and reply to this post with your adventure’s share link (click the 'share' icon on your adventure's main menu panel to grab that URL).
[*]You can also tweet your adventure’s share link with the hashtag #creativersecontest (make sure you’re following us so we can DM the winner’s deets).
[*]Deadline for entries is [b][u]Monday, April 10 at noon CBST[/u][/b] (Combeau Standard Time...sorry, he insisted; that converts to roughly 1:37pm Central US time).
[*]All aspects of the adventure will be judged, including title, screenshots and description in addition to gameplay and replayability*. Follow these suggestions for a competitive edge…
[list]
[*]Avoid excessively lengthy adventures. If it takes more than 15-25 minutes to complete, it’s too long.
[*]Playtest your adventure before submitting it. Even better: have other people playtest it. Figure out where they get stuck or frustrated and refine those sections.
[*]Mazes are fine, but consider using a variety of blocks and/or decor so each hallway doesn’t look the same. Also, avoid having large portions of your adventure be so dark you can’t even...
[*]Submitting an adventure we've already featured on the main menu is fine, but you may want to consider updating it somewhat to keep it fresh and competitive.
[/list]
[*]Limit one entry per person.
[*]Combeau will allow you to work together with others, but the prize will go to the person who submitted the winning entry. It's up to the winner to share their prize.
[*]Make sure you’ve registered your e-mail in Creativerse so we can contact the winner about that sweet sweet loot.
[*]Employees and family of employees of Playful may not participate (mea culpa, [url=http://sharing.creativersegame.com/w?k=9a28be2a020511e7b418aa166790b009]Domthro[/url]).
[/list]

[b]Prizes[/b]
At an undisclosed time after the April 10 deadline, and under the direction of Combeau the Contest Master**, we will announce our TEN favorite entries. We will then contact the creators to arrange for delivery of the following…
[list]
[*]One $25 Steam gift card
[*]One Creativerse Pro DLC key
[*]2000 game coins
[*]Featured adventure placement on the main menu
[/list]

*Replayability doesn’t necessarily mean it needs to include alternate routes/experiences to be deemed worth playing again. It could also simply be an awesome singular experience.
**Who may or may not be a figment of our producer’s imagination...

notes.title: Published Adventures!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/dWdLJ1P.png[/img]
Adventures are here!

It's an undisputed fact that the Creativerse community creates incredible worlds and experiences. Seriously, we looked it up in a book of facts and it was right there, next to "pizza is tasty".

The adventure system, new in R39, gives players the power to share their amazing worlds with... the world! Maybe your adventure is a labyrinthine maze where digging and gliders are off-limits, or maybe it's a tour of epic constructions featuring checkpoints you’ve set up at notable sites throughout your world. When the only limit is your imagination, there are no limits!

Plus, you'll be adventuring in style with a major set of character improvements, including new heads, hairstyles, color options, and better character lighting.

The book of facts is never wrong. Fire up Creativerse R39 and start turning your world into your own adventure today!


[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]New support for adventure publishing!
[list]
[*]New craftable item: Gate - used for publishing an adventure
[*]New craftable item: Checkpoint - used to add a checkpoint to an adventure
[*]Playable adventures coming soon to the main menu!
[/list]
[*]Player visual overhaul
[list]
[*]Improved models
[*]Improved color palette selections 
[*]Hairstyle improvements and additions
[/list]
[*]One special new rare recipe drop
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]General UI improvements and tweaks
[*]Significant player character lighting improvements
[*]Minor audio tweaks
[*]Banning a player also removes their touchstone from the teleport list
[*]Containers track a history of adds/removes
[*]Prevent mobs from spawner from sleeping when using ForcedAggressive
[*]Base power cell now pulls more things
[*]Wood power cell removed from crafting tree
[*]Charged wood power cell recipe no longer drops
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause toggleables to stop changing state(fans stuck on/off, etc)
[*]Fixed fire enable world option
[*]Fix for sensor sound always playing
[*]Fix for claim text overlapping with “F to interact”
[*]Fix for crash when placing a blueprint kit on a shelf
[*]Minor fix for male character shoulder geometry
[*]Fan sized down slightly so it does not go outside of a block
[/list]
